notes.title: Game Mode Changes & Additions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks!

This build changes most of the game modes to create a more progressive difficulty curve across the vanilla modes, and incrementally introduce the various mechanics that might be different from similar games.

My hope is that each of the new game modes will offer you new ways to experience the game and to discover some of the vast possibilities to customize it. Then go and create your own game modes and custom difficulties, because you can. ;)

[i]You can read some of the new possibilities in the patch notes below, check what the Game Mode editor can do, and of course when you are ready to take the next step: the Modding Guide in the Community Guides section.[/i]

[u]Coming week I'll be taking a short break from development, to just play and enjoy the game and maybe make some more Gameplay videos. [/u]

[b] So if you haven't already make sure to join our Discord server to share your feedback, ideas and to discuss balance. ;)[/b]

Let me know if you encounter any issues and of course have fun!

[h1] EA Build 0251  [/h1]

[h1] Misc Gameplay & Game Mode Related Changes [/h1]

[list]
[*] Edited several events to improve their functionality and add additional choices & options
[*]  Event nodes now have higher chances to trigger an event instead of a looting opportunity
[*]  Added separated (additional) nodes with card picking (drafting) opportunities
[*]  In Adventure Mode's Hourglass: Added a Preparation Phase (Spend 5 AP: Choose 1 out 4 Actions & Draw it.), Replaced the 'Exploration Action', New Exploration option costs 5 AP & has 45% chance to trigger encounter, 15% chance to yield a Ration, 15% chance to Choose an Action among 2 and will always yield 3 xp.
[*] Deactivated the Game Modes: Endless, Puppeteer (Savefiles using them should still work and you can still add them as mods if you miss them.)
[*] Edited/Changed the following Game Modes:
[list] 
[*] Adventure (Set difficulty to Normal)
[*] Draft (Set difficulty to Normal). Is now a Class/Race Draft. (The old vanilla Changeling/Jack of all Trades Draft Game Mode is renamed to 'Changeling' and is still available in the Game Modes folder but deactivated.)
[*] Expert Set Difficulty to Ironman++, Start with Empty Deck & all unlocked Skills available to add to your Deck
[*] Added 3 Puppeteer Game Modes: Mentalist (Normal+), Seer (Ironman+) & Demigod (Ironman++)
[*] Puppeteer now leaves the original nodes revealed. You can can use 'Continue' to proceed to the original node instead of altering it.
[*] All Vanilla game modes will display their simplified descriptions. (You can look up their detailed rules in the codex.)
[*] Increased all completion rewards to feel more rewarding
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] In Adventure mode: any town nodes encountered mid-stage are converted to the 'A Small Settlement' event.
[*] In Adventure mode: only 1 of the possible rewards was shown at end of the stage
[/list]

[h1] Modding Related Additions [/h1] 

[h1] Events Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Events can now support up to 15 different choices
[*] New 'Reward' property: RemoveChoice:AndRepeat, will remove the choice and then re-render it after re-evaluate its requirements. (Use this if a choice is repeatable, but it has requirements.)
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode Properties [/h1]

[list]
[*] "ActivateHourglass": true, will activate the Adventure mode Hourglass Button=>'Explore' Event in your current Game Mode
[*] Added Hourglass option in the Game Mode Editor under Special Handlers
[*] "BlankSlate":true, will remove all Cards, Class Skills & Perks from the character
[*] Added Draft + BlankSlate option in the Game Mode Editor under Draw Phase
[*] "ClearStartingDeck":true, will just empty the Starting Deck, to customize it faster (Manual Only)
[*] "AdjustSkillLevelReqsBy":x, will increase or reduce the Skill Level Requirements by x (Manual Only)
[/list]

[h1] EA Build 0251.1 - Hotfix [/h1]
[list]
[*] Some of the help (?) buttons weren't working after build 0250
[*] Some Summon cards were missing Racial type
[*] Summoning from a copy was causing in some cases Allies to lose their Racial type
[*] Targeting an Ally missing Racial Type with a TargetArchetype effect would cause an exception error
[*] In some cases 'Let's Train!' wouldn't work properly on Hunter's Wolf Companion and he wasn't automatically resummoned.
[*] Perks modifying ExpendBuff[Buff] will now work properly. Syntax is: ModifyEffectExpendBuff[Buff]:x i.e. ModifyEffectExpendBuffGrace:-1 (whenever you are Expending Grace you spend 1 less.)
[/list]

You can of course modify them like they were before or change the difficulty settings as you please if you feel this makes things way too easy. [i]Because it does. [/i] [i]If you still find Casual & Normal difficult I want to also remind you that you are more than your class: 1/3 of your card pool are racial cards, do take advantage of what they can provide and of course feel free to create easier game modes in the Custom Mode Editor.[/i] Additionally for the classes and races who feel more attuned unclad (Nymph, Witch & Spelldancer) their relevant archetypes now all rely in 'Grace' and will play better together. notes.title: Community Requested QoL & Modding Additions
notes.content:
Hi folks,

This build adds some of the QoL, and most of the Modding improvements you requested in Discord or in the forum in the past week. The requests I didn't add now, are either part of the roadmap anyway or I will be adding them at the later date. So stay tuned & keep the ideas flowing!

I will do my best to include both your suggestions but also to stick the plan. 

My main focus is of course the modding tools, not only because I need them for the Events I am developing these days, but because our community modders need them to provide you with new amazing experiences. 

[i]I am aware of some pretty cool mods brewing as we speak, and between us, very hyped to try them ;)[/i]

Have fun and let me know if you have any issues!

[b]If you haven't already, do join our Discord Server! You can find the link in-game. Or just use the steam discussion board ;)[/b]

[h1] EA Build 0248 [/h1]

[h1] Misc QoL Improvements [/h1]
[list]
[*] If you already have a game in progress and click the 'New Character' button, a confirmation dialog will now show up asking if you want to start a new game or resume your current game.
[*] Resting at the Town Inn will now advance the world calendar +1 Day and set the time at 09:00pm.
[*] When Previewing Archetype Cards in Character Creation screen, they'll now appear sorted in the following order: Starting Deck, Unlocked Skills, Unlocked Cards, Unlocked Cross-Discipline Cards & finally the Locked Cards
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Enemy Status icon was showing blank for Custom Actions with Custom Artworks
[/list]

[h1] Modding Changes & Additions [/h1]

[h1] Modder's Shell [/h1]
[list]
[*] (Yes you can use it to cheat too)
[*] You can toggle show/hide the Modders Shell by pressing F10
[*] You can press the Up Arrow key to repeat the previous Command
[*] Current Supported Commands:
[*] CreateCard [Cardname], will create 1 copy of Cardname to the Players Hand
[*] AddCard [Cardname], will add 1 copy of Cardname to the Players Deck or Inventory if it is Equipment
[*] DefineCard [1 liner Card Definition], will create a new card & add it to the Action Database for the duration of the run
[*] RemoveCard [Cardname], will remove Cardname from the Card Database (if this card is part of a tdb file just for the duration of the run)
[*] EmptyDeck, will completely Empty the players Deck & Discard their Hand
[*] ReshuffleAll, will force a Deck Reshuffle
[*] ModifyPlayer[HP,AP,XP,Farthings,Rations,Order,Karma],x 
[*] i.e ModifyPlayerHP,3 will give player 3 HP
[*] i.e ModifyPlayerRations,-1 will remove from player 1 ration
[*] ModifyMastery[Mastery],x will modify the players Mastery
[*] i.e ModifyMasteryHuman,4 will give +4 Human Mastery
[*] This can be used for custom races & classes as well
[*] It can also be used to Modify the player's tokens
[*] i.e ModifyMasteryTokens,5 will give the player 5 tokens
[/list]

[h1] New Modding effects & Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now use the Events LootOne as an Action Effect. To pick from a choice of 2-4 cards and add one to your deck. Illegal choices are disabled. Syntax for the Action effect is: LootOne[Cardname]#[Cardname]#[Cardname]#[Cardname]:1
[*] Farthings:x, can be used as Action effect to give or remove farthings from the player. Farthings can never drop below 0 (player be in Debt) or go above 1500 (current Farthings limit).
[*] Order:x, can be used as Action effect to give or remove Order from the player. Order can never drop below -100 or go above 100
[*] Karma:x, can be used as Action effect to give or remove Karma from the player. Karma can never drop below -100 or go above 100
[/list]
 
[h1] Contingency Actions Expanded with the following checks [/h1]
[list]
[*] OnCasterStatusFarthingsMore & OnCasterStatusFarthingsLess
[*] OnCasterStatusKarmaMore & OnCasterStatusKarmaLess
[*] OnCasterStatusOrderMore & OnCasterStatusOrderLess
[/list]

[h1] Localization files additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] New entries are below: ">>>>Patch 0248": "Entries below were added in Build 0247. Don't forget to include them in any older Localization files!"
[*] Edited the following entries:
[*] "TownRestAtInnMessage":"You wake up refreshed.\nYou restore 25 HP and AP & spend 75 Farthings.",
[/list]

[h1] EA Build 0248.1 [/h1]
[list]
[*] Modder's Shell - Additional Commands
[*] CloneCard [Cardname], will retrieve the definition of Card with an included ReUseArtwork statement, to quickly edit and create a variant of Cardname.
[*] StartEvent [Event ID], will fire up the event with ID = Event ID. i.e StartEvent Adventurer Corpse I
[*] NextNode [Node], will set the upcoming Node of the Stage to [Node] or to [Event ID]. i.e NextNode Elite
[*] JumpToNode [num], will set the current node index to [num] ie JumpToNode 1, will return player back to DungeonEntry
[*] JumpToStage [num], will set the current stage index to [num] ie JumpToStage 3, will jump the player to Stage 3
[/list]

notes.title: Two-Handed Weapons & Modding Additions
notes.content: [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img] Hi folks, This Build contains the introduction of Two-handed weapons & lots of modding additions either requested by our modding community or of new tools I needed as I was adding new Events. [i]And any tools I use to add the content are tools you can use too, to do the same in your mods[/i]. So if you aren't interested in modding, just feel free to skip these patch notes ;) Two-handed weapons work exactly as you expect. Equipping one / un-equips any offhand. And of course if you try to equip any offhand weapon or shield while using a Two-handed weapon it will un-equip. So while this is a feature that at this point is also aimed for modders, I too converted all weapons that made sense to be Two-handed into the new Two-handed system. In addition to that it's now possible to completely un-equip your weapon if that's how you prefer to roll, and rely exclusively in your deck cards. (There is also a fully implemented Order/Karma system, but don't mind it yet, unless you mod. [i]I'll tell you more details when I finish the events[/i]. There are some new events that you may encounter and depending your choices change your Order/Karma tendencies. But are very few, so really unlikely to encounter them at this point and to affect your runs.) [b]So have fun! And let me know if you encounter any issues![/b] [h1] EA Build 0247 [/h1] [h1] Misc Changes & Additions [/h1] [list] [*] Added a list with useful External links (Discord Server, How to play videos, Where to get Mods & Community Guides) [*] There was some cases that the player had to pick 1 card (among choices) but it wasn't mentioned in the choose card dialog. [*] Added New Random Events [*] Added Support for 2H Weapons. [*] The following Weapons are now Two Handed: Staves, Heavy Weapons, Claymores, Lances, Spears, Bows, Tridents, (most) Crossbows, Battle Axes [*] Slightly increased the damage of all Weapons that converted to 2-Handed as you can no longer have offhand with them. [*] Equipment cards just mention the type instead of Equipment (Main), card will display as One-Handed Weapon etc. [/list] [h1] Modding Changes & Additions [/h1] [list] [*] It's no longer necessary for the Class Archetypes to declare a starting Weapon or Equipment [*] You can now define 2H weapons. Define them exactly like before and also add is2H:1 [*] ie. Damage:3, Defend:1, Persistent:1, Slot:0, is2H:1, Actions:2, Tier:1, Element:Bludgeoning [*] If the player Equips a 2H weapon, any equipped offhand or shield items are unequipped [*] If the player Equips an offhand/shield while having a 2H Weapon equipped it will get unequipped before equipping the offhand item [/list] [h1] Contingency Effect Additions [/h1] [list] [*] You can now check if the Caster has a Custom or Vanilla buff less than a certain value: [*] If you have [Buff] but is less than x, then contingency triggers [*] Caster needs to have this buff at a non 0 value. So if they don't have it or it's more than x contingency won't trigger [*] i.e OnCasterStatusDefend--:3, is true if the Caster has Defend less than 3 [*] i.e OnCasterStatusDeus Ex Machina--:1, is true if the Caster has 'Deus Ex Machina' (CustomBuff) less than 1 [/list] [h1] Contingency and Conditional Effect Additions [/h1] [list] [*] You can now give a CustomBuff as part of a Conditional or Contingency Statement by appending ++: [*] OnCasterStatusDefend:3, ContingencyEffectVigilance++:1 [if the caster has defend 3+ they gain +1 vigilance] [*] OnCasterStatusVigilance--:3, ContingencyEffectVigilance++:2 [if the caster has vigilance but its less than 3, they gain +2 vigilance] [/list] [h1] Localization files additions [/h1] [list] [*] New entries are below: ">>>>Patch 0247": "Entries below were added in Build 0247. Don't forget to include them in any older Localization files!", [*] Edited the following Entries like so: [*] "CardRulesEquipment":"", [*] "CardRulesEquipmentEx":"Equipment: Usable once per turn.\n", [/list] [h1] Event/Tale system Additions [/h1] [list] [*] Choices that player don't meet their requirements will now hide instead of just deactivate [/list] [h1] Karma & Order [/h1] [list] [*] Events can reward the player Order & Karma (positive or negative) depending their Order/Chaos & Good/Evil tendencies. Using Karma:x & Order:x. [*] Similarly we can check if the players Karma or Order is greater/equal than x in Requirement fields: i.e Karma:5, will check if the player's Karma is >= 5, and Not:Karma:5 if the player's Karma is < 5 [*] For negative Karma Not:Karma:-5 to check if the player's Karma is < -5, or Karma:-5 to check if the player karma is >= -5 [*] It's up to you (the content creator) to decide how much Karma/Order the player will gain depending the Act, but generally none becomes pure Evil, a true angel, a Chaos incarnate or the beacon of Law & Order with a single act. And since this is a game values of -5 to 5 can give the player opportunities for redemption or to further sink to the darkness or to maintain a neutral behavior. [*] The concept of Morality is a deep conversation, but for the purposes of simplicity, Morality in Erannorth: imagine the popular commoner's beliefs in a medieval society during the Dark Ages and you are pretty close. [/list] [h1] New Requirement keywords for Events [/h1] [list] [*] HasDiscipline:[Discipline] can check if the player has a discipline despite not being of the class or of race [*] ie Class:Necromancer, HasDiscipline:Necromancer, will work for both Necromancers & classes who learned the Necromancer Discipline from a Perk [*] Level<:x, will succeed if Level is < x. (shortcut for Not:Level:x) [*] Similarly Karma<:x, Order<:x, Rations<:x (Removed RationsLess), Stage<:x, HP<:x, AP<:x [*] Stage=:x, will check if we are in the exact Stage (this would make more sense for non-Sandbox modes Events, but will still work in Sandbox events too Stage => Area level) [/list] [h1] New Reward keywords for Events [/h1] [list] [*] ChooseOne:[Cardname]#[Cardname]#[Cardname]#[Cardname], can be given as reward to allow the player to choose and draw a card copy. You can use 2 to 4 cards and also "Random Card", to pull a random card. [*] LootOne:[Cardname]#[Cardname]#[Cardname]#[Cardname], can be given as reward to allow the player to choose and gain an action card in their deck or inventory depending where this card belongs. You can use 2 to 4 cards and also "Random Card", to pull a random card. [/list]

notes.title: Maintenance Update + Hotfix
notes.content: Hi folks, This is actually a minor update, but the build is unnaturally large as is a maintenance update and upgrades the Unity Engine to the latest version. [b]So first run might be a bit slower than usual[/b]. Second should speed up things a lot, and game should overall perform better than before. If you have any issues let me know either in the forum or in Discord: https://discord.gg/CmnnneV [h1] EA Build 0246.1 - Hotfix & Addon [/h1] [h1] Maintenance Update [/h1] [list] [*] Updated Unity Engine to latest stable version (v2019.2.1f1). [b]This will increase the update size by a lot, as all binaries and libraries got rebuild from scratch[/b], so unfortunately there is no way around it. But the good news is that the updated Unity engine includes many improvements, performance optimizations & stability fixes and should overall perform faster after the second run. [/list] [h1] Bugfixes [/h1] [list] [*] When previewing a Racial or Class set in the Character Creation screen cards from Shared Disciplines and Additional Actions will also display there (if any). Such cards will now indicate that they are part of a different Discipline as well (as you need mastery in that discipline to unlock). [*] Passive Equipment Cards (Armors & Accessories) weren't gaining XP. (They will now gain +1 XP each turn they trigger.) [*] Invoke & ChooseOneRandom Card effects will no longer create Consumables or cards that have been explicitly excluded from loot (with ExcludeFromRandomLoot:1). Not a bug really, as Consumables also count as Action Cards, but it didn't make sense in most cases flavor-wise. Changed Human Card: Backpack as it no longer had flavor and as a consequence Sturdy Rope & Torch cards as well. [/list] [h1] Misc Changes [/h1] [list] [*] Enemy Gallery could take a long time to load in large Enemy Databases or in older rigs. Instead of displaying all Enemies right away, Gallery will load quickly blank & you can now just choose a Category which will be quite fast in most cases (or 'All' to view all Enemies like before.) [/list] [h1] Archetype Modding Additions [/h1] [list] [*] Archetypes Race & Classes can now count as additional races or classes for the purposes of targeting, immunities, weaknesses etc using "CountsAs":"Race/Class/Faction" (comma list) [*] i.e a Lich race could "CountsAs":"Undead, Mystic", will treat the Lich as both Undead and Mystic [*] i.e a Dhampir could "CountsAs":"Human, Vampire", will treat Dhampir as both human and vampire etc. [*] This will make the Race or Class a valid Target for TargetArchetype effects or relevant Auras like Desecrate or Consecrate. i.e a Succubus race could "CountsAs":"Demon" and properly receive Desecrate heal & Consecrate damage. Won't grant any additional cards or disciplines, and the additional templates doesn't have to be playable. In enemies for example CountAs will also affect their resistances to certain effects. i.e a custom Oakfolk enemy race could also "CountsAs":"Plant" and inherit all Plant immunities [*] Vampires & Death Knight Archetypes updated to use this new property, nothing much changed though as they were already counting as Undead [*] Runecaster Archetype updated to use this new property and now also counts as a Dwarf [/list] [h1] Build 0246.2 - Hotfix & Addon [/h1] [list] [*] 'Training' Wolf Companion would cause him to lose his artwork (Edited Card: Wolf Companion) [*] Invoke and ChooseOneRandom couldn't create Herbs as they are Singleton & Singleton cards were excluded from the card pool. Singleton cards that are also Spell Component cards were added back into the pool. [*] Fixed some issues in the Wildshape Loop both for Animist & Lycanthrope. [*] Replaced 'Claim Soul' from Demon's Skill list with 'Infernal Contract' (Claim Soul is supposed to be crafted only when certain circumstances are met) [*] Nerfed Wildshape loops for both Animist & Lycanthrope [*] Edited Cards: Wildshape, Hybrid Form, Claw Attack, Claw Strike & Feral Strike. [*] Hybrid Form each turn will now create a Feral Strike, which upon draw will create an additional (Reaction) Claw Strike [*] Wildshape (Animist Card) each turn will now create a Claw Attack, which upon draw creates a copy of itself [*] Edited Cards: Hunter's Brew (Penalty way too harsh) [/list] [h1] Modding Additions & Notes for Modders [/h1] [list] [*] Enlightenment effect can now target an Ally. If does the Ally will gain the XP instead. (You can enforce targeting an Ally if necessary using TargetTypeAlly:1) [*] Localization file changes: [*] "CodexEnlightenment":"Enlightenment x: A valid Target (You or Ally) Gains x XP.", [/list]

notes.title: Prologue/Tutorial Story
notes.content:
Hi folks,

This build adds a short prologue story/tutorial that will shed some light on your character's origin story & demonstrate a couple of game mechanics, through the eyes of Rysa & Trevor, two iconic members of the Canticum Noctis faction. Which you will get to know better in future stories.

notes.title: Class Card Sets, New Portraits, New Perks UI and more
notes.content:
Hi folks,

If you were in the main branch (0236.2) this is truly a huge update, that will probably shake the foundations of everything you know about Erannorth! 

Ok perhaps not, but still.

[u][b]I recommend to disable all mods that modify vanilla Races, Classes & Perks and any localization mods that are prior to Build 0240. [/b][/u]

Also if you are using my 'Rs Remove Gender Restrictions' mod uninstall it (or unsubscribe). You no longer need it as Gender restrictions have been replaced with a soft Recommendation.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/e13fec460e728733f0ba3545167a911acb6dee4c.jpg[/img]

Briefly: this Build adds the complete Class Sets, new Portraits, new Perks UI, a gazillion of new effects and goodies for modders and of course dozens of bugfixes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/1003bd1c9ea730a98aa3a5240bd7940c74b92de1.jpg[/img]

Below are the cumulative patch notes for Builds 0242 to 0245. (You can find the merged notes for builds 0240 & 241 separately in the forum.)

I sincerely hope you will enjoy these changes, and I am looking forward to hear your thoughts!

[i]For everyone who is eager to just get their teeth in the new cards without the grind, it's easy: Just find your ModManager.conf. Next to each Race & Class set the tokens to 0, and that's it. As simple as editing a text file. Even if I update this file, all Races & Classes will stay unlocked. Of course I don't recommend it. As reversing it is much trickier. But hey it's your game![/i]

[b]Last but not least, if you are using Discord, you can also join our community there: https://discord.gg/2MDpUDp ;)[/b]

[h1] EA Build 0245 [/h1]

[h1] QoL Improvements & Misc Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added button in Character Creation next to each Race/Class to quickly show their Cards in the fullscreen Card Viewer
[*] Cards that are either in the Starting Deck or are a Race/Class skill will indicate so (Any Cards in Deck is also a Skill)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/b808d2e2f046e179127953b63c91609e56c155eb.jpg[/img]

[*] Locked Cards will display with a 'Destroyed' graphic and a 'Locked' banner till they are Unlocked
[*] *Damage shown when previewing a Race/Class set is calculated based on the currently chosen Race/Class & Customized stats
[*] Log is one layer higher than the fullscreen Card Viewer (You can now use the card details info while previewing Card sets in Character Creation or Cards remaining in Deck)
[*] Log will automatically hide if the fullscreen Card Viewer opens. Pressing Esc (or x if you have started playing a character) will quickly Close the Card Viewer. (Press 'L' to reopen the log if you need it)
[/list]

[h1] Perks Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the way the Perks are displayed
[*]  Perks are now separated in 'Available' & 'Active'.
[*]  4 Columns of Available Perks & 2 Columns of Active Perks are shown at a time. (Both lists are scrollable)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/33945af688e978e7d7cc359d8bdcd4565a06c00d.jpg[/img]

[*]  Perks gained by purchasing them or by Events will display under the 'Active' list
[*]  Perks in 'Available' category are comprised by both Race & Class perks and are sorted by the Level they become available
[*]  Once a Perk is moved to 'Active' is removed from the 'Available' list
[*]  Added Buttons to Show all Perks, only Racial or only Class Perks
[*]  Reworked/Nerfed/Improved several Perks
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] There was a (visual) glitch in the Perks Requirements checker, showing as Red (not met) even when the player had enough PP to purchase the Perk.
[*] Disciplines weren't clearing up when switching archetypes ie. when previewing starting decks causing in some rare cases disciplines to stack
[*] Space will no longer "End Turn" while viewing the remaining Cards in Deck
[/list]

[h1] ModManager Settings & Modding improvements [/h1]
[list]
[*] There is a new panel in ModManager which lets you disable parts of the Vanilla Content i.e for a Total Conversion.
[*] You can now disable certain Vanilla Content like Enemies, Perks, Races/Classes & their Card Sets, and Vanilla Game Modes

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/527dc339c9b342e99146018f57e7b705376fee09.jpg[/img]

[*] If you Disable the Enemies, any Unlocked Enemies Codex Entries you have will be lost, even if you Re-Enable them. You can then Unlock them once more.
[*] You can also make the vanilla Portraits invisible in the Show All Portraits UI
[*] ModManager settings are saved in Windows Registry, so that each individual Erannorth Installation can have its own settings
[*] When Perks import fails Modding console will try to pinpoint the error further, by displaying the last successfully imported line
[/list]

notes.title: EA Build 0241 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
Hi folks!

I know I said, that I'll leave my keyboard in the attic for the next 8 days, but. There are two features I had promised and didn't make it into 240 build. 

I added them both in today's build, along with 130 new portraits to accompany you in your new adventures.

So yes. The first thing you'll notice is that we now have 65 new Portraits for Male & 65 new Portraits for Female characters that will offer you more variety. The portrait format is exactly the same, so all the Portrait mods will keep working as before: Top half becomes part of your Character card, and the full portrait is shown only in your Character Sheet.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/1003bd1c9ea730a98aa3a5240bd7940c74b92de1.jpg[/img]

Of course it's still Daz! So Daz haters, sorry. I am sure you will still hate them.

But, I hope that this new presentation will merge better with your own custom portraits, as they no longer use a full body view or transparency. So you can go get some of the cool fantasy portraits out there, drop them into to your mod folder still as png (as per previous instructions) & all done ;)

Which brings us to the first promise: A way to quickly choose portraits. What if you have let's say 200 portraits or 1000? Well, there is now a button above the Character Avatar. Once you click it, all your custom and vanilla portraits will appear in a gallery form. Just click any of them and it's set. ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/2c6abc4924689a44d86ae287a6a591a58df23215.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/18f7e36cfaef49fb7aa928516c63d15873e070b5.jpg[/img]

If it's a portrait you like to use along with a certain class or race, you can save it as one of your presets. Which brings us to the second promise: You can now also save the assigned attributes (and unallocated points) along with the portrait, race & class choice in one of the two Preset Slots. If you die, stats will still reset. So if you really want them to be saved, save them in a Preset Slot.

So that's all for today! Have fun and see you again in 8 days!

[h1] EA Build 0241 (Development Branch) [/h1]
[list]
[*] Switched to a new Portrait System
[*] Vanilla Portraits in existing save games & preset slots should switch to a corresponding new portrait, you can then change it to the one you like once you start a new game.
[*] Added 65 Male & 65 Female Portraits
[*] Added a Button that will show all vanilla & custom portraits. Clicking on any will set it as the character's portrait
[*] When Saving a Preset in Slot I or II, the current Attributes & unspend Points will save as well
[*] If you load a legacy Preset (saved before Build 241) your Attributes will be set to 0, you can just click on the Reset button and resave the preset with the new system.
[/list]

notes.title: Huge Content Update! (Development Branch)
notes.content: [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img] Hi folks! Build 0240 is now in the Development Branch and it's huge! How huge? Let's just say it has over 320+ new cards, a gazillion new Action effects & mechanics and lots of changes and improvements. So take things slowly as almost nothing is as you knew it ;) These are the highlights: [list] [*] The minimum Deck size is now 18 cards. Except for Draft (Still 12 Cards in Draft). [*] All Classes now have 80 Cards, that they are no longer shared and new Assignment of Starting Decks & Skills. [*] Runecaster became a Dwarven caste that you can pick as a Race instead of a class. [*] I removed the gender restrictions from races & classes (added though a soft recommendation) [/list] I'll leave this build in the Development Branch (and my keyboard in the attic) for 8 Days and fetch my notepad to do some world building. After that still need to add/edit new Perks in all races and classes, and continue with the rest items I mention in the Roadmap, so keep that in mind as you test the new Card Sets: That Perks will slightly change to accomodate new Cards, and reduce the: 'you get +2 Astral meh feeling.' I also don't expect the sets to be totally balanced, so it would be nice if all of you switch to the Development Branch and spend some quality time with this build. :) Trust it's more stable than the one in main branch, and you can always revert if something goes wrong and you get tons of new content! What's not to like? On the other hand, if none gives me feedback is what you'll end up getting :P So Dev branch! Win win situation. ;) Looking forward to hear your thoughts on the new Card/Skill Sets and how its combination you tried performs! [h1] After Updating to 0240 [/h1] I recommend to disable any localization mods, and any mods that modify vanilla classes & races then start a new game. [h1] EA Build 0240 - Development Branch [/h1] [h1] Completed Card Sets [/h1] [list] [*] Each Class set now has 80 Cards. [*] Runecaster is now a Race (A Dwarf Caste to be more precise) instead of Class, and has 40 Cards [*] Modified the .json files of all Classes & Races [*] Adjusted the Proficiences & Resistance of all Races & Classes [*] Adjusted the Initial Skills & Starting Decks of all Races & Classes [*] Races & Classes can now contain a Description field. [list] [*] ie. "RaceDescription":"Race description goes here\nthis is a new line." [*] ie. "ClassDescription":"Class description goes here\nthis is a new line." [/list] [*] Added flavor/lore descriptions in all classes and races [*] Removed Gender Restrictions. (They are now just recommendations.) [*] Players start with 18 Cards + 1 Equipment [*] Min Deck is now 18 Cards for all modes except Draft. (Min size in Draft is still 12) [/list] [h1] Bugfixes [/h1] [list] [*] When Smart Casting an Action to First Enemy or Ally, and they are already marked for destruction, Action will attempt to Target the next available Enemy or Ally, till they find one or evaluate the first 5. [*] There was a typo in the preview text of Allies with the Legacy Defensive Stance, messing up the preview text formatting [*] Death Knight counts as an Undead in addition to their Race [*] Discard effect was looking for Actions in the Battlefield not in the Hand i.e could Discard cards in the Choose One Dialog instead from Hand [*] Fixed a couple formatting errors in the Combat Log caused by Localization [*] Caught an exception when using chaotic actions and the target has died [*] Improved Invoke/Choose One Random algorithm [/list] [h1] Notes for Modders [/h1] [h1] Localization Additions & Changes [/h1] [list] [*] Localization file updated for builds 0240+. You can find the new entries below the build marker: [*] ">>>>Patch 0240": "Entries below were added in Build 0240. Don't forget to include them in any older Localization files!", [*] Added the key association for looking up Statuses & Keywords in the Codex [*] The following lines in English.json were changed: [list] [*] "CodexFreeze":"Frozen/Frostbite x: Target gains x Frozen counters & can't Act for as long as they have these counters. Additionally loses 1 HP per counter. Non-Immune Enemies have a 25% chance to resist this effect.\n\nWhen damaging an Immobilized, Frozen or Bewitched Target, 1 counter breaks for every 3 damage dealt (above 3). ie 1 counter if dealt 3-5 damage, 2 counters if dealt at 6-8 damage etc. If the card both deals damage and inflicts the status the damage required to remove a counter increases by +3.\n\nFor Players this Status is converted to 'Frostbite'. Instead of 'Unable to Act' Player loses 3 AP per Frostbite Status.", [*] "CodexRetribution":"Retribution x: Distribute up to x Intense Damage to each Enemy attacking you this Turn.\n\nRetribution Damage is a kind of damage deposit. If it is not completely used up by an opponent, the remaining surplus is passed on to the next opponent and so on. When all opponents act, you lose all remaining Retribution.", [/list] [/list] [h1] The following DoTs will now affect the Player similar to how they affect the enemies: [/h1] [list] [*] Bleeding x: Player will lose 1 HP / Bleeding Status. [*] Burning x: Player will lose 5 HP / Burning Status. [*] Envenomed x: Player will lose 3 HP / Envenomed Status. [*] Frostbite x: Frozen Status will affect the Player as Frostbite. Won't get immobilized but will lose 1 HP & 3 AP / Frostbite Status [*] These effects will be set with Bleed, Burn, Venom & Freeze if the Actions that have them target the Player [*] They can also be set with CustomBuff[Buff] i.e CustomBuffFrostbite:2, CustomBuffBleeding (when we want to inflict them to Player, prevent the optimal target changing to Enemy & prevent affecting the Enemy) [/list] [h1] New Action Effects [/h1] [list] [*] [b]ControlArchetype[Archetype/Faction]:x[/b], If Target is (of) [Archetype] & has Power less/equal than x, they become an Ally for [Card Level] Turns. Once the effect ends they are removed from Combat. [*] [b]TargetArchetype[Archetype/Faction]:1[/b], Unless the Target belongs in the required Archetype or Faction, Action will Fail. [*] TargetArchetype can also be non-Undead [*] [b]TargetType[Self,Ally,Enemy]:1[/b], Unless the Target is of the required Type, Action will Fail. (Unlike Optimal Target this is a hard requirement for the Action to Work.) [*] [b]CustomBuff[Buff]:x[/b], Player gets +/-x "Buff". This "Buff" doesn't have any effect on each own, however it can be used in conjuction with contingency effects. [list] [*] i.e CustomBuffVengeance:3, Player gets Vengeance 2. Vengeance doesn't exist as a Buff. The modder made it up. [*] OnCasterStatusVengeance:4, ContingencyEffectWrath:8, if the Player has Vengeance 4 deal 8 Wrath Damage etc. [*] i.e CustomBuffClarity:2, Player gets Clarity 2. [*] OnCasterStatusClarity:2, ContingencyEffectSense Thoughts#:1, if the Player has Clarity 2, craft the Card Sense Thoughts etc. [*] Custom Buffs will Debuff along with Defend,Retribution etc. during the Debuff phase [*] You can use ie. CustomBuffDefend:x, to adjust the player's Defend (or any other existing Buff). [*] CustomBuff has the highest trigger priority after Empower, so it will trigger before the Contigency effect resolves [/list] [*] [b]DebuffAll[Buff]:1[/b], Player loses all their points of Buff. [list] [*] i.e DebuffAllDefend:1, Player loses all their Defend. [/list] [*] [b]ExpendBuff[Buff]:x[/b], Player loses x points of Buff. If they can't Action fails. [list] [*] i.e ExpendBuffVigilance:2, Unless the player can pay 2 Vigilance Action fails. (Vigilance 2 is a CustomBuffVigilance:2) [*] if the Action triggers multiple times ie. due to Multicast or Fury, Expend Cost is paid only once. [/list] [*] [b]Afterimage[Cardname]:x[/b], After this Action (successfully) resolves, Create and Play x [Cardname]. You don't pay its AP cost, but still pay any Expend costs normally. [Cardname] Targets automatically You, Your first Ally or Your first Enemy (depending who is the Optimal Target). A card can have only one Afterimage effect. [*] [b]BloodTribute[Cardname]:x[/b], If after this Action (successfully) resolves its target dies, Create and Play x [Cardname]. You don't pay its AP cost, but still pay any Expend costs normally. [Cardname] Targets automatically You, Your first Ally or Your first Enemy (depending who is the Optimal Target). [*] [b]Flavor:[Text][/b], will add a flavor text at the end of the card description [*] [b]OverrideDesc:[Text][/b], will override the card text with a fixed text (no numerical values are calculated). Flavor will append to that text if it exists. [list] [*] Both Flavor & OverrideDesc can't have the , character in their text. If you need one use the ; character. It will be replaced with a comma: [*] i.e [card effect], OverrideDesc:Deal 5 + Card Level Intense Damage; if the Target is Witch; Warlock; or Necromancer., [next card effect] [/list] [*] [b]Blood Offering:x[/b], Lose x HP & Gain x/2 Blood Surge. Blood Surge can be used by Blood Mages to trigger various additional effects in their Actions. Any Unused points Debuff at End of Turn. [list] [*] (This effect could have been recreated by using negative Healing and a CustomBuff, but whereas Card Upgrades reduce the HP cost they increase both Blood Offering cost & gain and I wanted to be able to use it as a Synergy.) [/list] [*] [b]Spell Component:1[/b], This card won't trigger any Active Synergies, but instead Modify or Expand them with additional effects. [list] [*] i.e You play a card with Synergy Damage & Synergy Defend. If the next card is not a Spell Component those effects will be added to the next card you play and trigger as normal. If it is a spell component they'll be ignored, and any synergies in the Spell component will be added in the Active Synergies. [/list] [/list] [h1] Build 240.1 - Hotfix [/h1] [list] [*] Several Blood Mage cards had Blood Tribute 'Funnel Blood', where the correct card name is 'Blood Funnel' [*] Smart Cast could cause an exception if the Smart-casted Card had a mistyped or incorrect name [*] 'Combat Schooling' targets & Unsummons a Nomad before choosing either Upgrade. [/list]

notes.title: Updated Roadmap for Erannorth Reborn
notes.content:
Hi folks, with full Modding support & most things in the old Roadmap already done, it's time for an updated Roadmap. 

Below are the (most notable) tasks I'll be working on during the last 3 months of the EA. 

Most of these updates will include as finalized content as possible. So I'll be switching to (even) larger & less frequent (weekly or bi-weekly) patches to give us the time to evaluate their impact in the overall Balance.

You should already have your hands full testing the new Race Sets ;)

The next patch, probably sometime before mid-August will include the final drafts of the Class Card sets. 

They will each consist of about 70-80 unique (not shared with any other Disciplines) Cards. So for 15 Classes, I estimate that this will add 300-400 new cards in the game, and even more cool mechanics for Modders to play with ;)

[h1]Updated Erannorth Reborn Roadmap[/h1]

[List]
[*] Complete the Class Card Sets. (Each Class Card Set has 70-80 unique Cards that aren't shared with other Disciplines.)
[*] With Both Race & Class sets complete, re-evaluate Starting Skills & Starting Decks.
[*] Diversify, change the existing Perks & Add new Perks to better support and allow a variety of builds even within the same Class/Race combo.
[*] Add additional Enemy AI responses and extra Enemies.
[*] Add random Events & mini Stories for both Adventure & Gauntlet Modes.
[*] Interactive Tutorial/Prologue story introducing the basics and the world to new players.
[*] Polish the UI, add more eye-candy, VFX & SFX.
[*] Add an Advanced Rulebook to supplement the in-game Codex.
[*] Additional Features & QoL improvements requested by the Community.
[/List]

End of EA will signify a new beginning not the end. So after EA, development will continue at the same tempo, focusing this time on new content both for Modders and Players.

notes.title: 150+ New Cards, QoL improvements & Modding Additions
notes.content: [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img] Hi folks, [b]I am sure that [i]aside very few exceptions[/i] everyone loves new content. And this build brings in a huge amount of new content![/b] Nope, I don't mean just the Localization & Workshop Support, even though they are now official in and I am really looking forward to play your creations! [b]Build 0236 adds about 150+ Cards & implements the final drafts of the Racial Card sets.[/b] [h1] Final Drafts? [/h1] All 9 Races now have their own unique Card Sets of 40 cards each, and they no longer share cards with any of the classes like before. Ok. Nothing is really final ever is it? By final draft, I mean that as long as I won't have to meddle with & adjust their balance in the coming days, I won't be adding any more [b]Racial[/b] Cards [b]during the remaining 3 months of the EA[/b]. After all we are already in 1444 Cards, and almost all Class Card sets are still incomplete ;) However which of these cards are the Racial Skill Cards [u]will be[/u] changing once I also finalize the Classes Card Sets Draft. [h1] Balance? [/h1] For those who joined us more recently let me state once more that by "vanilla" balance *I never mean an equilibrium of Power* between the various Races or Classes. A Vampire, a Sylph & a Human aren't equal in Power, neither they should. So whenever I refer to balance I mean between each individual Class/Race combination vs your Enemies ;) As long as you have fun and the game is challenging. Is all the balance I care about. You are of course welcome to adjust things as you see fit and share your overhauls with us through the Workshop ;) [b]You can read about all the changes you missed in detail in the Community News section. As the Patch Notes below are just for the Build 0236.[/b] Enjoy the new Cards & the Workshop possibilities and let me know your thoughts or if you encounter any issues! [h1] EA Build 0236 [/h1] [h1] Misc QoL Changes [/h1] [list] [*] In Chests: Added a text indicating how many items can be picked from a certain chest (i.e if its a draft chest 1, if it's not as many items as are in there) [*] Cards in Hand: The former 'Card Hover' SFX will now play only when you click on a card to drag it [*] In Adventure Mode: Clicking on the Hourglass button, while enemies are present will remind you of any node rules active (i.e Leyline Affinity & Aversion). [*] In Combat Log: Next Synergy will display after all action effects have resolved and before the Concentration/Fatigue drop in a distinctive color [/list] [h1] Bugfixes [/h1] [list] [*] Combat Log was opening whenever typing a Character name containing the Log's shortcut 'L' [*] After the Localization implementation: Save & Load Preset buttons had wrong text labels [*] After the Localization implementation: Contingency & Conditional Trigger texts had formatting issues in their Card Texts [/list] [h1] Notes to Translator Modders [/h1] [list] [*] Updated the following lines in English.json file: [*] "CombatLogSynergy":"Synergy {0} {1}*.", [*] "CombatLogSynergyModification":"Next Action gains {0} {1}*.\n", [*] "CombatLogSynergyActive":"Active Card Modifications: ", [*] There are some extra lines added in English.json under the line: ">>>>Patch 0236":"Entries below where added in Build 0236. Don't forget to include them in any older Localization files!", [/list] [h1] New Action Effects & Improvements [/h1] [list] [*] Contract: If Target Dies while Contract is active, bring them back as an Infernal Servant Ally. [*] Contingency Actions Expanded [list] [*] Contingency Actions can now check if the Caster has a certain Buff (Retribution, Defend, Empower, Concealment etc.) [*] i.e OnCasterStatusConcealment:10, will check if the Caster's Concealment is more than 10% [*] Contingency Actions can now check if the Caster has a certain Damage Type Amplified (Fire, Earth etc.) [*] i.e OnCasterStatusFire:5, will check if the Caster's Amplify (Fire) is more that 5 [*] Contingency Actions can now check if the Caster has a certain Echo Action in Effect with duration greater than the value [*] i.e OnCasterStatusFeed +*:2, will check if Feed is active (Echoing) & has more or equal than 2 duration [*] (There isn't a check to see if the value of the above check is less than x) [/list] [/list] [h1] Quality of Modding Improvements [/h1] [list] [*] Added a Modder's Console in the Main Menu, otherwise invisible unless an import error occurs somewhere while loading a Mod. [*] When Importing a DB with Errors, Game will attempt to just skip the file or the bad entry and display an error message in the Modder's console. [*] This error message is more specific in Card & Enemy entries pinpointing the bad entries exactly and more generic in other files mentioning just the file name with the error. [*] i.e if you see Archetype Error: Demon, it means that there is something wrong with your Demon.json file [*] Not all errors can be caught this way, but should still help you eliminate the most common typos and mistakes while making mods. [/list] [h1] EA Build 0236.1 & 0236.2 [/h1] [list] [*] Added a Button in Mod Manager to show the Modder's Console [Show Error Log] [*] Added a Button in the Modder's Console to Hide it [Hide Error Log] [*] Fixed some card definition typos in the Cards generated by 'Ready your Bow!', their conditional effects will work properly now. Added the Reaction keyword in them. [*] Slightly adjusted the Card Frame & Card Text Autofit size to display a little better text-heavy cards. [/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0235 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
Hi folks,

This build almost finalizes the Localization support, and I think that over 95% of the text resources in Erannorth Reborn can now be translated in other languages. It might be obvious, but I have to mention it: you can also have localization Mods that changes the English translation of the game to American English, British English, grammatically-correct English (because as you know I am not a native speaker) etc. Or to otherwise change things as you see fit.

The (randomly :P) estimated 5% includes a few things I might missed by accident, the Custom Game Mode Editor & the Adventure UI. [i]I'll be adding the text resources for the Custom Game Mode Editor & the Adventure UI at a later time. The Adventure UI is pretty much a work in progress and may end up changing a lot, and the Custom Game Mode Editor may end up as part of a separate toolkit (still undecided on that).[/i]

If you are planning to start working on translating the core localization file (English.json) you can safely do that. If you are already working on a translation mod, 'Notes to Translator Modders', section below contains important information on how to update your existing files to this build (and any future builds that will add things in the localization file) easily.

I didn't have any issues with any of the development builds so far, and I think it's safe to merge it with the Main branch. But I will wait till the next build to do that, which will give me time for some additional testing (just in case). [u]So if you encounter any strange issues or texts that are messed up in formatting or otherwise in the wrong place let me know![/u]

Last but not least I have uploaded a Guide in the Guides section on how you can add your Mods to the Workshop, and a link to Steam Guidelines for user-generated content in the Discussion Board for easier access. So after checking the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1055990/discussions/1/3140616601475346107/] Steam Guidelines [/url] and the How-to Workshop Guide please try to upload your mods there and let me know if you encounter any issues! It will be nice fixing them before merging the branches. ;)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1815584432


[h1] EA Build 0235 (Development Branch) [/h1]

[h1] Localization Support Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added some missing texts in Character Creation & Character Sheet
[*] Added texts for the Town UI
[*] Added texts for the Victory/Death Screen
[*] Added missing Preview Texts (in Enemy, Allies, Actions, Skills, Perks etc)
[*] Added texts for Enemy & Card Details, 
[*] Added Combat Log texts
[*] Adjusted more text fields to be dynamic as the translation character lengths can vary and cause characters to cut out
[/list]

[h1] Notes to Translator Modders [/h1]

To make easier to maintain your localization mods and since the localization.json files don't support comments, I added a fake variable:

">>>>Patch 0235": "Entries below were added in Build 0235. Don't forget to include them in any older Localization files!",

You can add a comma, in the final entry of your localization file, and copy paste everything below this line. Whenever I have to update this file, I'll be including a similar fake variable to help you distinguish the newer entries.

[h1] QoL Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added text headers in Combat Log to separate Player's & Enemy's turn entries
[/list]

notes.title: Initial Steam Workshop Support
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Build 0234 adds the initial support for Steam Workshop, which you can now use as an alternative way of modding Erannorth Reborn, as both the Workshop and Self-contained mods will happily work side by side.

[strike]Build 0234 is only available in the Development branch[/strike], and mods you will subscribe will only work if you are using this Build (0234) or a later one.

For the coming days all the new patches and updates will be heading in the development branch, so I'll have the time to finalize the Localization support and with your help ensure that everything works fine. ;)

Now let's talk about the Workshop integration :)

[h1] Information for Players [/h1]

a) The Mod Manager won't install or uninstall Steam Workshop mods, neither they'll display in that list. Only Mods installed in your Mods Folder can be managed there. However it will tell you how many active Workshop Subscriptions you have (if any).
b) To manage your Steam Workshop Subscriptions use the Steam Workshop page. (There is a new button in the Mod Manager to take you there.)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/b390d28d7dbc7d67af0b2259947860ea474683eb.jpg[/img]

c) If Erannorth Reborn is running, after subscribing/unsubscribing to and from any Mod, always restart the Mod Manager.
d) Restarting the Mod Manager will activate any Steam Workshop mods you are Subscribed, and deactivate any mods you are Unsubscribed

[h1] Information for Modders [/h1]

There is a new button in the Mod Modmanager, that you can use to access the Steam Workshop Uploader. There you can fill in the simple form and upload your Mod to Steam Workshop.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/8c8f5387f888c9a0b470fce2a2196dd766c2780a.jpg[/img]

You need:

a) [b]Your Mod name [/b]

i.e Rs Remove Gender Restrictions 1.2

b) [b]Your Mod description[/b] 

i.e This mod removes gender restrictions from the classes & races that have them

c) [b]A comma-separated tag list [/b]

i.e Races,Classes

d) [b]A path pointing to the folder with your mod files[/b]

i.e E:\Documents\Mods\Rs Remove Gender Restrictions

e) [b]A path pointing to a 256x256 or 512x512 preview image[/b]

i.e E:\Documents\Mods\Rs Gender Restrictions Preview\preview.jpg

That's it. You click Upload and your mod is now in the Steam Workshop. You can further edit the description, tags and other details from there. ;)

Have fun folks! 

[b]And please don't abuse the Workshop, I would really hate it, if I have to play the police and ban people for abusing it ;)[/b]

notes.title: Initial Localization Support (Dev Branch)
notes.content:
Hi folks,

This build won't seem to change much at a first glance. And it shouldn't (visually), as "all" it does is taking the text resources in the game (a very large amount of them) and loads them dynamically from an external file (Language.json). So everything should feel & read the same.

[b]But under the hood, this build changes literally a hundred of things, in countless game functions, so it is very likely to contain bugs that weren't there before. And let's say it will stick around in the Dev branch for quite some time.

So please let me know if you get into any issues, even if you don't attempt to translate the English resources.[/b]

The current Language file (../Localization/English.json) currently contains texts from: 

[list]
[*] Main Menu
[*] Settings
[*] Manual & Help Entries
[*] Game Mode Rules
[*] Enemies Statuses
[*] Action Effect Codex Entries
[*] Card Rules
[*] Character Creation
[*] Character Sheet
[/list]

[i]This file is still missing several text resources i.e. Most of Combat Log output, Town UI, Adventure UI, Custom Mode Editor etc.[/i]

The important thing to note is that almost everything in Erannorth is loaded from external text files, and they can too contain translatable texts directly. i.e Perks, Events even Race & Class json files contain their own translatable text. Those resources won't be included in the Language.json file. 

[i]So what makes a Translation mod? Almost a different ../Content directory. [/i]

My recommendation (if you decide to create a translation mod), is to provide a separate mod for the Language.json file i.e a French.json, and then a separate mod that overrides the English vanilla files like Perks, Events, Locations etc that translates them i.e to French.

[h1] EA Build 0233 - Development Branch [/h1]

[h1] Initial Localization Support (WIP) [/h1]
[list]
[*] Localization.json files can be found in ../Content/Localization/ or ../Mods/[Your Mod]/Localization
[*] You can activate a different Localization file by declaring it in the ModLoader under the >> Language section i.e French
[*] You'll need to copy the English.json file rename it to French.json, and also set its id to "Language":"French"
[*] The Localization.json file currently contains: Main Menu, Settings, Manual & Help Entries, Game Mode Rules, Enemies Statuses, Action Effect Codex Entries, Card Rules, Character Creation, Character Sheet
[*] Other texts that were already localization-ready in their respective files: Events, Locations & Areas, Perks, Game Mode Descriptions. Even Cardnames could be localized but it's not recommended as you'll then have to change & override all race, class & action definitions and then use ReUseArtwork, to link them back to their english-named artworks.
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Exorcist was missing their Light/Dark Training Perks & their Expertise & Mastery Light/Dark Perks were unlocking at wrong levels
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0232
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

This build brings several improvements and modding additions in the Adventure Mode, a new (and very highly requested) Action Effect and a much smarter auto-casting system when using the right-click shortcut.

You can read more details in the patch notes below!

[h1] EA Build 0232 [/h1]

[h1] Balance Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Enemies can use their Counter Attack ability 1 or 2 times depending their 'Counter Attack' counters. Once they use the ability they lose a 'Counter Attack' counter and may reapply 1 or 2 on their next turn (if they don't have any.)
[*] Counter Attack Rule changed to: 'Unless attacked with a Ranged Action and as long as this enemy has a 'Counter Attack' counter, they will 'Counter Attack' & lose one of their counters.'
[/list]

[h1] Perk Related Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Replaced the perks that were shared between Races & Class.
[*] If a perk is included in both a Race & a Class .json files only the Race definition will show
[*] Perks can still be shared between Races or between Classes but each Race/Class combination now has unique perks
[/list]

[h1] Adventure Mode Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Whenever clicking on an Adventure Location a confirmation dialog will now appear displaying further info on this location, environment, leylines and a preview of its completion rewards

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/9bf1bb3abb3de684a5cef3837058f14b2998bb68.jpg[/img]

[*] Whenever clicking to travel a Placeholder confirmation dialog will also appear, which will in the future display more info on the target location
[*] Added a banner indicating that the area is complete. Player can click the 'Return to World Map' button to return back to map or choose a reward for completing the area

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/465eadd4ab4eb36435a19b7610be88d1e55a216d.jpg[/img]

[*] Imports/Exports button in towns and location will display their imported & exported commodities
[*] Added 34 Commodity Cards. Commodity Cards can be acquired as Adventure Rewards and can be traded in Towns for Farthings
[*] Added Imports/Exports & Possible Commodity Drops in all adventure locations
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] SacrificeAlly:x, will now display as Sacrifice Ally (X). Its previous text will display in the details text box.
[*] Smarter 'Auto-Casting'
[list]
[*] Armor, Accessory, Cards you Right-Click & Ally Special Abilities that are cast automatically are now smarter and take any active synergies into account
[*] Autocast cards will now first determine the optimal target of their effects based on active synergies
[*] If the action is or has become harmful (due to a previous echo action) and an enemy exists they'll target the first enemy instead of the player
[*] If the action requires to target an ally and an ally exists, the first ally will be chosen as the target
[*] If the action can't target the first enemy (no enemies are around at the resolution time i.e start of encounter) or can't target an ally (no allies are around) or isn't harmful the card will instead target the player. 
[*] Right-click handler will switch to Manual mode for any cards with Enemy target if no enemies exist in the battlefield
[*] Even if the card ends up targeting the enemy, the player still gets all the benefits but the enemy acts as the target. An Echo action will exist as long as that enemy target exists.
[*] Even if the card ends up targeting an ally, the player will get all positive benefits except healing. An Echo action will exist as long as that ally target exists.
[*] You can reorder the enemies and allies any time, and in case of potentially harmful armor effects the best time would be before ending your turn
[*] That doesn't change how you cast cards manually: Feel free to ignore the optimal target (if you know what you are doing) and drag the card in any target you like ;)
[/list]
[*] Notes to Modders:
[list]
[*] This gives us more freedom i.e to have Ally Abilities that target allies or Passive equipment designated to target enemies or allies instead of only synergizing the harmful effects
[*] Echo Actions are not cast automatically, they target their original target, so any harmful effects synergized in Echo Actions that target the player, will still harm the player
[*] OnDrawCastSelf & OnDrawCastFirstEnemy are also not cast automatically, they will target on draw, their designated target: player or the first enemy (if it exists)
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Location Areas Modding Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*]You can set Completion Rewards (Cards) for each Adventure Area using "Area_x_Rewards":["Cardname 1","Cardname 2", "etc"],
[*] You can set a Cover Artwork for each Adventure Area using "Area_x_CoverArtwork":"ArtworkName"
[*] You can set a Flavor Description for each Adventure Area using "Area_x_Description":"Short Description using \n to indicate new lines"
[/list]

[h1] New Action Effects [/h1] 
[list]
[*]ChooseOne[CardName]#[Cardname]#[Cardname]#[Cardname]:1, Choose One: [CardName] or [Cardname] or [Cardname] or [Cardname].
[*] Choose one can be used to choose from 2 to 4 Cards
[*] i.e ChooseOneCharge#Taunt:1, Choose One: Charge or Taunt.
[*] i.e ChooseOneFear#Panic Attack#And Now Sleep:1, Choose One: Fear or Panic Attack or And Now Sleep.
[*] Instead of a card name you can use 'Random Card' 
[*] i.e ChooseOneRandom Card#Fear:1, Choose One: Random Card or Fear.
[*] i.e ChooseOneRandom Card#Random Card:1, Choose One: Random Card or Random Card.
[*] When the effect resolves 'Random Card' is no longer a random but a specific card randomly choosen card, so you can see which card it is & choose it or not.
[*] There can only be a single 'ChooseOne' keyword per card
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Gravedigger had a typo in his ability Definition, and it wasn't showing/working properly
[*] Activate Cards & Cards Respace functions weren't called after passive equipment (Armor or Accessory) effects resolved, so cards wouldn't respace or become inactive if the player lacked the AP to use them.
[*] Allies who persisted across multiple savefiles, could in some case lose their portrait
[*] Synergy-Modified Optimal Target text in actions could persist in some cases in the next node, even after the synergy modifying it was cleared due to EoT
[/list]

[h1] EA Build 0232.1 - Addon [/h1]
[list]
[*]In Adventure Mode: Each Area will now offer various card reward options (in addition to the commodity cards added in main build), and let you expand & enhance your Adventure Deck outside the scope of your class & race.
[/list]


[h1] EA Build 0232.2 - Hotfix [/h1]
[list]
[*]In Adventure Mode: Area Reward Equipment was added in the Deck instead of Inventory.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0231
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

If you are in the Main branch this patch is quite large both in size (~100mb) & in content. It contains over 200 new Actions, new mechanics & many changes in existing mechanics.

You can read what's new in 0231 Build below, and my recommendation (if you haven't been following the news) is to also check all the patch notes below and start a fresh run.

[list]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1055990/announcements/detail/1589125169128716833]EA Build 0228[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1055990/announcements/detail/1590251701183727811]EA Build 0229[/url]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1055990/announcements/detail/1590251701187173298]EA Build 0230[/url]
[/list] 

I didn't discover any bugs so far in my tests, so if you find any let me know. Also now that the dust is settled, I am looking forward for your feedback on this week's cumulative changes both in Balance & Gameplay.

In the meantime & unless something urgent occurs and you need me, I'll be spending the weekend playing Erannorth with Lucy Liu's & Zirkumflex's new Class mods ;)

You can find them in the links below, and of course if you like them don't forget to endorse them! ;)

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/erannorthreborn/mods/7/?tab=description] Minstrel class by Zirkumflex[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/erannorthreborn/mods/8/?tab=description]The Tempest and the Tinker Classes by Lucy Liu[/url]
[/list]

Have fun!

[h1] Patch Notes - EA Build 0231 [/h1]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Reducing the Max HP i.e from a Perk wouldn't refresh right away the Current HP if they were more than the Max HP
[*] If the ally's ability was a synergy, the preview text wasn't showing the ability description before the ability was activated at least once.
[*] Cards in Hand wouldn't be adjusted properly to fit in certain cases. They will now adjust both when playing & drawing cards
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated Tutorial slide about Perks
[*] When hovering over a Perk's scroll, the whole perk will highlight for easier distinguishing which perk you are previewing
[*]  Consumables Button was renamed to 'Backpack', and in addition to Consumables will also fetch any Trinket cards you have in your Deck (see details on Trinkets below)
[/list]

[h1] Action Effects - Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Conditional & Contingency Trigger Additions
[list]
[*]  Echo actions can now be treated as a counter in Conditional Triggers by using [Card Name +*] as [Counter]
[*]  So you can now essentially create any type of counters to test for OnEnemyStatus[Counter]:x, AddEffect[Effect]:x
[*]  i.e OnEnemyStatusAnd Now Sleep +*:1, AddEffectChaotic:8, will Add the Chaotic effect if the enemy has the 'And Now Sleep' counter
[*]  Conditional & Contigency Triggers can now use a Synergy as an Effect but by adding a * in the end of the effect
[*]  i.e AddEffectChaotic*:8, will add a Chaotic Synergy effect instead of the Chaotic effect
[*]  Conditional & Contigency Triggers can now use Spellcraft as an Effect but by adding a # in the end of the effect
[*]  i.e AddEffectSloth#:1, will Spellcraft the Demon 'Sloth' card instead of triggering the "Sloth" effect
[*]  i.e ContingencyEffectPanic Attack#:1, will Spellcraft the Illusionist card 'Panic Attack'
[/list]
[*]  New Action Type - Trinkets
[list]
[*]  You can create Trinket cards by defining them using both Singleton & Trinket keywords i.e Singleton:1, Trinket:1
[*]  Trinkets cost more than other cards of with otherwise same tier (or uses if they are consumables)
[*]  Trinkets can be bought in Towns at the Consumables & Trinkets section
[*]  Trinkets can be quickly accessed by using the 'Backpack' button along with your Consumables (Once per turn discard your hand to fetch the first 4 trinkets or consumables in your Deck)
[*]  There is not a limit how many trinkets and consumables you can have in your Deck, however the Backpack button will only Fetch 4 per turn
[/list]
[/list] 

[h1] EA Build 0231.1 - Minor Hotfix & Addon [/h1]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] ReUseArtwork wasn't transfering on the Summoned Ally, after a card with ReUseArtwork had been used to Summon them
[*] In Buff display a positive Fatigue value will now display with red, as having Fatigue is a negative buff
[/list]

[h1] Modding Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Custom Events can now re-use misc vanilla resources (That doesn't change the way you can use your custom graphics)
[*] Artwork Graphics from the Action Cards using "Discipline/Card Name" in the graphics field. ie. "MainGraphic": "Spelldancer/Courtesan",
[*] Artwork Graphics from the Enemy Cards using ">Enemy Artwork" in the graphics field. ie. "MainGraphic": ">Admiral Sinclair", (Normal Enemies Artwork filenames don't always match the Enemy Name. You can find them in the EnemyDB)
[*] Artwork Graphics from the various Background Cards using "*CardBack1-11" in the graphics field. ie. "BackgroundGraphic": "*CardBack1",
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0230 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

Today's build introduces a New Perk Acquisition system, many additions that modders will find useful for their custom card sets and the initial infrastructure to implement imports/exports and commodities in the adventure mode.

I would recommend a fresh run as the old and new perk system aren't meant to play well together. ;)

[i]We are still in the development branch, and unless there are any unforeseen bugs or issues Friday's build should be heading in both branches.[/i]

Overall I think, that these cumulative changes we are currently testing, have disrupted the game balance in a positive way, and make things more challenging and interesting (especially in Ironman difficulties).

So I hope you are enjoying these new changes as well, and of course I am looking forward for your feedback!

[h1] EA Build 0230 (Dev Branch) [/h1]

[h1] Level Up System Additions & changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Level up will now also award +(20 x Level) PP (see Perk System changes below)
[*] Reduced the amount of XP earned as now they are not reduced whenever you gain Perks
[/list]

[h1] Perks System changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Locked Perks you can't unlock will now display dark red, and Locked Perks you can unlock will display dark green.
[*] Perks are passive bonuses and abilities your character can choose to learn by spending earned PP.
[*] Buying Perks will no longer hinder your level progress
[*] Every level you get +(20 x Level) PP. They stack and you can spend them whenever you like. However your character can gain a limited amount of PP during their adventures, so choose wisely when and how you'll invest them!
[*] i.e you get 20 PP at Level 1, then +40 at Level 2, +60 at Level 3 ... etc. If you save them all by Level 3 you'll have 120 PP. You can spend 50 of them any time, and save the rest for a later level.
[*] A Level 10 Adventurer can in total distribute up to 1100 PP
[*] Adjusted all Perks costs to match better the new Perks Systems
[*] You can now define Prerequisite Perks
[*] ie. [Water Magic Mastery, 120, Water Magic Expertise] instead of [Water Magic Mastery, 120] will add to Water Magic Mastery the prerequisite perk of Water Magic Expertise
[*] Defining a prerequisite perk is optional and can be ommited.
[*] Added Prerequisite Perks in any perks that are part of a chain i.e Water Training, Expertise & Mastery etc.
[*] Perk requirements you pass & fail will appear color-coded when you hover on it to see its description
[/list]

[h1] Action Card Modding Additions [/h1] 

You can use these additional (optional) properties when defining actions:

[list]
[*] [b]ReUseArtwork:[string][/b], Instead of using the Action's name for the artwork, you can reuse a vanilla or a custom one in your actions: i.e ReUseArtwork:Broadsword, will set this cards artwork to 'Broadsword.png'
[list]
[*] ie. UserArtwork:1, ReUseArtwork:Fireball, will use or reuse as artwork your custom artwork Fireball.png
[*] i.e. ReUseArtwork:Spelldancer/Courtesan, will use or reuse the vanilla image Courtesan.png, that is located in the Spelldancer folder. 
[*] The vanilla file structure is Discipline/Card Name.png, i.e if you click on the Cat Burglar, it'll say Discipline Shadow. Therefore to use his artwork in a card you define: ReUseArtwork:Shadow/Cat Burglar
[/list]
[*] [b]Commodity:[string][/b], You can specify that Card is a commodity of a certain type. i.e Commodity:Spice
[list]
[*] Only non-Equipment Actions can be marked as a Commodities
[*] Commodities are 'minor burdens' in your Deck, you can still discard them, but they can deprive you of a card draw
[*] Commodities cards can only be given as Event rewards (i.e Loot:Folkswave Coffeebeens) and they can't be converted to skills
[*] Of course you can craft them in a way that replace themselves i.e also have Focus:1
[*] You can define the commodity as any type you like, but as long as you do this card will be marked as sellable to merchants [Sell Commodities]
[*] You can specify a specific price or have the price determined automatically: Commodity Autocalc Price = 75 + (125 x Tier x Merchant Whim)
[/list]
[*] [b]SubElement:[string][/b], Action Damage source will display as that of SubElement (for flavor) i.e SubElement:Ice, card Element will remain that of the set Element, i.e Water.
[list]
[*] Damage source remains intact & your enemy will still receive Water damage.
[*] Element:Ice, will still cause an Error, in ER Ice is a subElement of Water.
[*] If a SubElement is defined, i.e SubElement:Thunder You still need to define Element i.e Element:Air. Then the card Element will display as Element (SubElement). i.e Air (Thunder), and Damage as [This deals x Thunder Damage]
[/list]
[*] [b]SummonRace:[string][/b], Summon's Race will set to that of the SummonRace:[string], i.e SummonRace:Undead
[list]
[*] Added the SummonRace definition in all the Summons. 
[*] SummonRace will now properly determine the result of various existing effects like Consecrate & Desecrate (and laying the groundwork for future effects to only affect allies of a certain race.)
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] New Location.json properties [/h1]
[list]
[*] Exports & Imports, are string lists containing a locations exports & imports (should match the tags you have set in your commodities)
[*] i.e Let's say we have 2 Commodities: Spice & Sugar
[*] if in a location they are Imports ( "Imports":["Spice", "Sugar"], ) it means that they are not native, have to be imported thus are more expensive (up to 30% more) to obtain than normal
[*] if in a location they are Exports ( "Exports":["Spice", "Sugar"], ) it means that they are in abudance, thus are cheaper to obtain than normal (down to 30% less)
[*] This up to/down to 30% increase (or decrease) in the good price, replaces the normal fluctuation rate of (-20% to 20%)
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a "Sell Commodities" button in Town, any Commodities you have in Deck will display there and you can sell them
[/list]

[h1] Bug fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Selling equipment was displaying the proper (updated) value but was paying player the (former) value in farthings
[*] Restarting the Mod Manager will also clear the class & race prefs (in case the saved class/race combo no longer exists)
[*] When the ally was dealing the killing blow even though xp were awarded they weren't display in the combat log
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0229 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

This is a really huge patch. It brings over 150 new Actions in the game that will give you many new allies and different option to expand your tactics.
  
A new 'Consumables' button that allows you once per turn to discard your hand & draw four random consumables from your deck. 

New AI responses and many additional balance changes that I hope will make the game & particular Ironman mode somewhat more challenging.

And many more things you can read in the patch notes below.

[i]This build is currently available only in the Development branch, but hopefully everyone will have it by the end of the week as well.[/i]

I hope you'll enjoy these changes! 

Either way, I am looking forward for your feedback to fine-tune things further :)

[h1] EA Build 0229 (Dev Branch) [/h1]

[h1] Misc Changes & Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added over 150+ New Actions & Summons
[*] Consumable Related Additions
[list]
[*] Consumables still take up space in your deck and you can draw them instead of a skill card
[*] However you can now click on the (new) consumables button to: Discard your entire hand & fetch (the first) 4 Consumables (left) in your Drawpile
[*] Consumables that can be used more than once have the new Singleton keyword. You can only have 1 copy of them in your Deck.
[/list]
[*] Added a manual entry for both 'Consumables' & 'Shuffle Deck' buttons.
[*] Each of the Shuffle Deck & Consumables buttons is only usable once per turn.
[*] Cards with Cursed, Unravel & Fleeting will not be discarded when using the Consumables or Shuffle Deck buttons
[*] Core Node Rules (activated through NodeBasedRulesActive): Currently contain only Night Cover & Nocturnal Rules
[*] Ambush Rules can be activated independently using the game mode properties below
[/list]

[h1] Balance Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*]  Ambush Ruleset is now by default active both in Ironman & Pupeteer modes
[*]  Ironman Mode Enemies now have 1.2x more Health.
[*]  Cutthroat Merchants
[list]
[*]  Merchants are overall more expensive and will buy your second hand equipment at 1/4 of the price instead of 1/2
[*]  Merchant prices will Fluctuate from -20% less to +20% more of the generated base price with max price = 1500 farthings
[*]  Removed the manual-set prices from (most) vanilla actions & equipment that had them to use the algorithm-generated prices instead
[*]  User manual-set Prices with 'BuyingCost' remain won't be increased neither discounted and will remain unchanged
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode Properties [/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]"EnemyCanAmbushPlayer":true or false[/b], activate or deactivate the Ambush rules
[*] [b]"EnemyAmbushChanceAtNight":x[/b], chance to be ambushed during night time
[*] [b]"EnemyAmbushChanceAtDaytime":x[/b], chance to be ambushed during day time
[*][b] "ShowOnlyModeDescription":true or false[/b], if true & a ModeDescription exists only this description will be shown and the run modification ruleset will stay hidden
[*] ShowOnlyModeDescription, is now set to true in (vanilla) Casual & Normal Modes (Run modifications won't display to be feel less intimidating to new players)
[/list]

[h1] New Action Keywords, Effects & Improvements [/h1]
[list]
[*]  [b]Singleton:1[/b], You can only have one copy of this card in your Deck.
[*]  [b]Reaction:1[/b], If this card is still in your Hand after playing a card, Discard it.
[*]  While Fleeting cards last till the end of turn, Reaction cards can survive the end of turn and will last till you play a card.
