[*]  If a player has 2 or more Reaction cards in hand they can only play just 1.
[*]  [b]UnsummonAlly:1[/b], Unsummon Target Ally (need to target an ally)
[*]  [b]OnDrawCreate[Card Name]:x[/b], Upon Drawing a Card with this effect, Create and Draw x [Card Name] copies
[*]  Unlike Spellcraft[Card Name] this effect is resolved instantly as the card gets drawn (whether or not the player ends up playing the card having this effect is irrelevant)
[*]  To prevent flooding hands with infinite copies: 
[*]  Copies created from OnDrawCreate that create themselves, won't replicate further.
[*]  i.e a Card named "Replica", has OnDrawCreateReplica:2. Upon Drawing it you will create two copies of the Card Replica, but the replication will stop there.
[*]  i.e a Card named Replica, has both OnDrawCreateReplica:1 & SpellcraftReplica:1. 
[*] Upon Drawing it you will create 1 copy of the Card Replica, and the replication will stop there.
[*] Upon Playing it you will Craft a Replica copy that will cause the OnDrawEffect to trigger, giving an additional copy of Replica. Replication will stop there.
[*]  Additionally there is now a hard cap size in Hand of 20. If the player reaches that cap, no more cards will be created or drawn (whether their equipment, actions or copies) till they discard some of their cards.
[*]  Perks that increase Spellcraft effect should also increase the OnDrawCreate effect (By manually adding the bonus in them i.e Coven Rituals: ModifyEffectSpellcraftCoven Witch:1, ModifyEffectOnDrawCreateCoven Witch:1, etc.)
[*]  [b]OnDrawCastSelf[Card Name]:x[/b], Upon Drawing a Card with this effect, Create and Use on Self x [Card Name] copies
[*]  [b]OnDrawCastFirstEnemy[Card Name]:x[/b], Upon Drawing a Card with this effect, Create and Use on First Enemy x [Card Name] copies
[*]  Text space aside, any number of OnDraw effects can be present in a single card
[*]  SynergyActions:x, can now modify the AP cost of the next action & will display as "Your next Action costs +/-x AP.", for better clarity
[*]  AllyAbility, can now take a Synergy as ability by using the * at the end of the definition. i.e AllyAbilityFocus*:1, will translate to SynergyFocus:1 instead of Focus:1
[/list]

[h1] New AI Responses & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Shield[/b]: Whenever the shielded enemy is dealt Damage, instead of reducing their Health remove that many Shield counters. (Shield can absorb any type of Damage even Intense, up to the number of Shield counters.)
[*] [b]Flank[/b]: You lose -2 Defend for each Flank counter in play, at the time this effect resolves. (Penalty won't be readjusted if any enemies flanking you die, but when your next turn starts.)
[*] (Improved AI Response) Dispel: Enemies will no longer try to dispel you if you don't have any buffs (like Defend, Retribution, Concealment or Empower etc.) active
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0228 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
Hi folks,

The highlight of this build is the introduction of a new choice wheel, that is currently used to replace the puppeteer event whenever you are about to change a node.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/94bec9dc26c9b7cf09ce53a2273def044b351c2f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/98e046e358a57f2fc3a390f2199742eaeeae7607.jpg[/img]

The puppeteer wheel currently comes with two behaviors: Either all choices can be active, or there is a chance that certain choices are active.

The vanilla Puppeteer and Draft modes will use by default the second behavior, as is the most familiar from similar games: For example in one node, you may be able to choose Encounter, Elite or Camp, and in the next only Encounter or Elite etc.

This wheel can be activated in any game mode by setting a puppeteer handler & the two new game properties. It can also be disabled and you can use the Puppeteer event instead like before, or use the wheel but switch to a different behavior. 

i.e All choice are always active, and your sheer force of will is the only thing preventing you to camp your way to the boss.

All these options are also available through the Game Mode Editor.

The second important addition is a Reshuffle Deck button, which allows you to discard your hand, and then shuffle it along your discard pile back to your deck, so that the next turn you may draw cards from your entire deck.

[b]These changes are currently only available in the Development branch.[/b]

You can read more details in the patch notes below!

[h1] EA Build 0228 (Development Branch)  [/h1]

[h1] Puppeteer Wheel [/h1]
[list]
[*] The puppeteer event has been replaced in the vanilla modes that use it (Puppeteer & Draft) with a puppeteer wheel.
[*] The new puppeteer wheel can either have all choices active or make a chance-based decision which options are active (Encounter is always active)
[*] For example in one node, you may be able to choose encounter, camp & grimoire but in the next encounter or elite encounter etc.
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode Properties [/h1]
[list]
[*] "UseVisualPuppeteer":true or false, is this is true AND "OnAdvanceNodeEvent":"Puppeteer", instead of using the puppeteer event will use the new puppeteer wheel
[*] "VisualPuppeteerIsProcedural":true or false, if false all puppeteer options are active, otherwise all options (except encounter) now have a chance to either be active or inactive, if the visual puppeteer is turn off, this setting has no effect.
[*] Vanilla Puppeteer & Draft Modes now include both these options by default
[*] Both options can be set in Custom Game Mode Editor [Fire Event When Changing Nodes], Choose either Visual Puppeteer (All Choices Active) or Visual Puppeteer (Procedural Choices)
[/list]

[h1] Reshuffle Deck Button [/h1]
[list]
[*] There are cases when you want to change your deck and to start accessing the new cards you choose right away but they've been added in the discard pile. 
[*] Or perhaps what is left at your deck make your hope of survival really thin
[*] You can use the 'Reshuffle Deck' button above your backpack to discard your entire hand and then shuffle it along with your discard pile back to your deck
[*] The only drawback is that you won't draw any new cards before your next turn, so use, abuse or not use this button as you see fit ;)
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] When resuming the game the player's cards in hand were staying in the drawpile too
[*] Some Perks were giving a different bonus than the one mentioned
[/list]

[h1] Default vSync [/h1]
[list]
[*] Default vSync is now locked at 60 fps instead of 'Don't Sync'.
[*] If you had your vSync to either 60fps or at 'Don't Sync' it will now automatically convert to 60 fps. If you had it at 30, it will remain as is.
[*] If you have a good rig, don't care about the perfomance cost & didn't have any issues with this vSync mode you can still manually set it at 'Don't Sync'.
[*] Either way I would recommend to check the settings and see if everything else is as you left it ;)
[/list]

[h1] Build 0228.1 - Hotfix [/h1]
[list]
[*] Advancing node with space would leave the puppeteer wheel on
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0227
notes.content:
Hi folks,

After the introduction of the Special Abilities to our Allies, the next logical step was to (re)introduce the dilemma: Attack? Or use the Special Ability. As in most cases it had become a 'Duh! Of course I'll use the ability'.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/903e79049d317f5ec45d92fa50a3c2f4b842c40d.jpg[/img]

To balance out the introduction of these abilities and make summon gameplay a more viable and interesting choice. I've been testing some changes: 

a) Allies are now quite powerful and tough, and the higher their Tier & Card level the more stronger and tougher they become. Summoning them will also cost you a much higher amount of AP (than before) in most cases. But it's a worthwhile investment. They can deal more damage, survive longer & level up faster.

So is attacking better now? The answer I've been aiming for with these changes: is depends. Whether to attack or to use the special ability should no longer be a straightforward choice. Attacking seems the obvious choice. But if you consider that your Ally Special can benefit from the active Synergy, and in what ways this can be beneficial, you'll realize: the possibilities are endless. 

On the other hand the higher the Ally level, the better the ability will be and attacking yields more XP, plus they can deal some serious damage. Hmm.

b) The second change brings a second dilemma: If you could only have 3 allies active at a time, which allies would you summon? Most characters can only have active up to 3 allies, and more specialized classes like Animists, Witches, Necromancers etc can increase this limit up to 5, by investing in two perks: Apprentice Summoner & Expert Summoner. Summoning over your limit will unsummon the leftmost allies, till you end up with allies equal with your limit. 

You can read more details in the patch notes below. 

Now that the allies revision is somewhat more complete, I am looking forward to hear your thoughts & to fine tune the mechanic & the ally abilities further.

[h1] EA Build 0227 [/h1]
 
[h1] Ally Rules Revision & Other Ally-related changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] All Ally/Summon Cards got a (significant) boost in their Power & Health to better match enemies of their Tier and the assorted adjustment in their AP Costs
[*] Ally/Summon Cards stats will improve more with each card level, than before:
[list]
[*] Power Increase Before: (Empower + Card Level) / 2, Power Increase Now: Empower/2 + Card Level
[*] Health Increase Before: Empower + Card Level, Health Increase Now: Empower/2 + 2*Card Level
[/list]
[*] Most characters can now control up to 3 Allies at a single time. Summoning Card expanded rules text will remind you of this limit: "You can control up to x allies at a time."
[*] 'Apprentice Summoner' & 'Expert Summoner' Perks both will increase this limit by +1 up to the Max of 5 Allies. (Only Animists, Blood Mages, Exorcists, Necromancers, Warlock & Witches have access to these Perks)
[*] If you attempt to create an ally above your limit the leftmost (first ally in the row) will be unsummoned.
[*] The same will also happen if you have fewer allies than your limit but the card you use creates 2 or more simultaneously
[*] You can however rearrange allies to decide which ally gets unsummoned
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/f9a608f26f1448b9cb7f5997ae5767f0d9dce90c.jpg[/img]

[h1] Misc UI Improvements [/h1]
[list]
[*] In Town UI: Added a Sell Equipment Button in Towns. Selling Equipment won't advance the World clock
[*] In Character Sheet UI: Clicking on the card image in Skills, Equipment or Deck sections will now display in the Log the Card Info Details text
[*] In Player's Handbook: Card Details will now include the Card Element
[/list]

[h1] New Action Effects [/h1]
[list]
[*] Quick Draw:1, Discard (your Current) and Draw (your Active) Main & Offhand Equipment.
[/list]

[h1] EA Build 0227.1 - Hotfix & Addentum [/h1]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Ally Ability: 'Sloth', will properly trigger the 'Sloth' action effect and no longer create the Demon Card named 'Sloth', that was added in 0227.
[/list]

[h1] Modding Related Changes & Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] To prevents problems like the above happening, since you can control the card names but not the effect names, when definining an AllyAbility a [Cardname] will be created only if an Effect with that name doesn't exist, if an effect exists it will be used instead. If no such effect exists but a card exists then the card will be created like before.
[*] If you really want to create a [Card], just make sure such an effect doesn't exist by looking it up in the Terms Codex. And if it does rename the [Card] or create a copy with a different name.
[*] You can now define a custom Summon/Ally Limit, using "SummonLimit":x, in the Archetype declaration of a Race or Class
[*] By default if Both Race & Class have a SummonLimit of 0, the Summon Limit will be set to 3 (all vanilla races & classes)
[*] if Either the Class or the Race have a SummonLimit their Sum will be used instead.
[list]
[*] i.e "SummonLimit":2 in a Race & "SummonLimit":4 in a Class will set the Summon Limit of the combination to 6
[*] i.e "SummonLimit":0 in a Race & "SummonLimit":2 in a Class will set the Summon Limit of the combination to 2
[*] i.e "SummonLimit":0 in a Race & "SummonLimit":0 in a Class will set the Summon Limit of the combination to 3 (vanilla limit)
[/list]
[*]  You can also create perks that expand the Summon Limit, by using 'SummonLimit:x'.
[list]
[*]  i.e 
Apprentice Summoner, 50
Your Summons have +1 Power & Health Bonus. Your Ally/Summon Limit increases by +1.
ModifyEffectPower:1, ModifyEffectHealth:1, SummonLimit:1
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0226
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

This patch enhances the changes from the Dev Build 0225 and makes Node-Based Rules optional by turning them into a Game Mode property.

Additionally it adds a new Node-Based rule "Enemy Ambush" and a new optional mechanic "Leylines", which makes the environment affect certain elements in a positive or negative way. In some stages helping you, while in others hindering you.

The only vanilla Game Mode they are currently activated is the Adventure Mode, but you are free to disable them completely or add them to more Game Modes, as those properties can also be set in the Custom Game Mode editor, and further fine-tuned manually.

I hope you'll enjoy these changes! Looking forward for your feedback.

[h1] EA Build 0226 [/h1]

[h1] Enemy Ambush [/h1]
[list]
[*] If the Node Ruleset is active in your Game Mode, Enemies have a chance to Ambush you.
[*] There is a 30% chance for an Ambush at Night & a 10% chance at Daytime
[*] This chance will further increase by +10% if the enemies are an 'Elite Encounter'
[*] When Ambushed:
[list] 
[*] Enemies won't attack first, they'll however have some significant advantages over the player
[*] Player starts with -2 Defend per Enemy
[*] If its night all Enemies will start with at least 2 Concealment counters
[*] Enemies with the Concealment response always start with 2 to 4 Concealment Counters
[*] Enemies with the Poison response will always start with 2 to 4 Poison Counters
[*] Enemies with the Flying response will always start with 1 Flying Counter
[*] Enemies with the Spiked Armor response will always start with 1 Spiked Armor Counter
[*] Enemies with the Warcry Response will activate their Warcry
[*] Enemies with the Gallop Response will activate their Gallop
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Leylines [/h1]
[list]
[*] Leylines will affect how certain elements perform on an environmental basis
[*] Each environment can either offer a bonus (affinity) or a penalty (aversion) towards certain elements
[*] Light, Dark, Earth, Water, Air, Fire, Astral & Poison Damage Sources are all affected by Leylines in one way or another
[*] Slashing, Piercing & Bludgeoning (Physical Damage) are not affected by Leylines
[*] While the aversion & affinity of the environment is fixed, the magnitude can vary on node by node base from -3 to -1 & +1 to +3
[*] For instance in a Marsh Environment Astral Actions can deal +1, +2 or +3 Damage, but in an Arid (Desert) environment -1, -2 or -3 Damage. etc.
[*] Leylines will additionally affect Summons of these elements and make them Stronger or Weaker affecting power at 1:1 rate & health at 1:2 rate
[*] i.e +2 Light Leyline Bonus will grant a +2 Power & +4 Health to a Summon of the Light Element
[*] Leyline modification will appear in the combat log at the start of each encounter. Additionally if a Leyline ends up modifying an Action's Damage or a Summon's Stats a relevant message will display in the combat log
[*] Added a new 'Leyline' entry in the codex: "Leyline attunement to certain elements is based purely on the environment. Leylines can provide an affinity boost (or an aversion penalty) to specific Elements, thus helping casters attuned in their element & hindering casters of opposed elements."
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode Properties [/h1]
[list]
[*] "NodeBasedRulesActive":false or true, Enables or Disables all Node Based Rules except Leylines (Default is false / Disabled)
[*] "LeylineRulesActive":false or true, Enables or Disables the Leyline Rules (Default is false / Disabled)
[*] "LeylineAffinityMin":x, & "LeylineAffinityMax":x, (x should be positive & neither 0) can change the default 1 (min) to 3 (max) range to the desired range
[*] i.e "LeylineAffinityMin":3, "LeylineAffinityMax":5 
[*] "LeylineAversionMin":x, & "LeylineAversionMax":x, (x should be negative & neither 0) can change the default -3 (min) to -1 (max) range to the desired range
[*] "LeylineAversionMin":-5, "LeylineAversionMax":-2
[*] If you like the concept but not the RNG you can set both Min & Max at the same value
[*] "HoursPassWhileShopping":x, When refreshing (searching a merchant's inventory) in towns this much hours will pass in the world and shops will eventually close (The default value of 0 in vanilla modes, means 1 or 2 hours. Use -1 to Disable this System)
[*] 3 of these properties [NodeBasedRulesActive, LeylineRulesActive, HoursPassWhileShopping] can be set with the Game Mode Editor [Node-Based Rules & Leylines] and [Time Spend Shopping in Towns] sections
[*] LeylineAffinityMin, LeylineAffinityMax, LeylineAversionMin, LeylineAversionMax can only be set manually
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved the Encounter selection algorithm to increase variety within the same group
[*] Node-based Special Rules will display simply as 'Node Rules'
[*] Node-Based & Leyline rules will display color coded dark green / dark red, depending if they are beneficial or harmful
[*] Both Node-Based Rules & Leylines are disabled by default & can be activated on a Game Mode basis
[*] The only vanilla Mode with them active by default is the Adventure Mode but you can activate them in any game mode
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Disrupting of the Tween animation updates could in some rare cases cause exception errors
[*] Node special rules where displaying before time advances, showing inaccurate results
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0225 (Dev Branch)
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Today's build - which for now is only available in the Dev Branch - introduces 'specials rules' and a more prominent Day/Night cycle in all Game modes.

Special Rules will be 'environment, race or lighting conditions'-depended rules that will apply on node by node basis. For instance if it's Night time your Concealment receives a 5% bonus, if it's Daytime a -5% penalty.

Vampire Drain effects are much stronger at Night, but at Day their Healing effect is penalized etc.

Once the time or condition changes perhaps in the next node even, the Special rules will also change.

I'll be adding more special rules in the next 2-3 builds, so if you have any ideas on that I am all ears ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/50966449ddf59d1cb2841dc5c742cb9a4cf9b969.jpg[/img]

Also, they informed me that the Merchants in Folkswave finally unionized, so from now on you can only find them working from Sunrise to Sunset.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/cf78663e0e0bb8ff18bc39ed0ecffd9dcdd1ad9e.jpg[/img]

Hope you'll enjoy these changes, looking forward for your feedback!

You can read more details in the patch notes below:

[h1] EA Build 0225 (Dev Branch) [/h1]

[h1] Special Rules [/h1]
[list]
[*] Depending the environment, race or lighting conditions some action effect may get stronger or weaker in a node by node basis.
[*] A message will appear once you enter a node displaying any special rules in effect
[*] Concealment Effect receives a 5% bonus during Night & a -5% penalty during Day
[*] Vampires receive a +5 in their Drain Effects at Night & a -5 penalty at their Healing Effects at Day
[*] Penalties and bonuses apply in the final result as bonus or penalty. i.e if a card heals +4 HP, with the Nocturnal penalty will heal -1 HP
[/list]

[h1] Town Related Additions & Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the World Clock in the Town UI
[*] Resting in the Inn will advance time by 8 hours
[*] Searching for new merchant stores (refreshing merchandise) will advance time by 1 to 2 hours
[*] Stores will now stay open from Sunrise till Sunset (6 to 19). Any other time they'll be closed. 
[*] Visiting a town early in the morning will give you more time to search the stores, rather than visiting it late evening and visiting a town in night wouldn't make much sense unless planning to rest or loiter there.
[*] You can advance the game clock (and wait till the shops reopen) by resting in the Inn, Adventuring or Loitering.
[*] When you Loiter, you Spend 5 AP & the World Clock advances by 2 hours
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Time will now advance by 1 to 2 hours each time you visit a new node (instead of by x hours when completing the stage)
[*] Added the World Clock widget above the Player's XP indicator
[*] Battlefield graphics will become slightly darker from 20 to 5 (Dusk, Midnight, Night)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0224
notes.content:
Hi folks,

This build brings a major change in the 'allies' gameplay as well as some minor improvements into the Town UI.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/72e6d9a54964d19fa1cf11443536fe987e0a1465.jpg[/img]

The common use for allies so far was to either use them to attack your enemies, or have them guard you & provide a defend & retribution bonus. 

But what if each ally could have its own unique activated ability? 

Perhaps right-click them to (instead) draw you a card or cause a malady to your enemy like freeze them, burn them, or weaken them etc. Giving you more and more tactical options with each ally in play?

I really hope you find this prospect enticing, because that's how your allies work now. ;)

Even though some still provide their old special of Defensive Stance, most allies (Over 90 in fact) will now provide a distinctive special ability once you right-click them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/7ad72bda461279d76552c55ecc8519796d137319.jpg[/img]

So if you have any allies in play in your current save file, is highly recommended to start a new game!

You can read more details in the patch notes below, experiment & of course ask me if you have any more questions about this new mechanic.

But the short version is:

a) You can right-click allies to use their special ability on the first enemy. They get all the negative effects & you all the positive effects.

b) You can drag and drop enemies to re-position them in the battlefield.

c) Using the ally ability counts as using a card, therefore any active synergies are injected into your ally ability.

[h1] Town UI changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Town Merchants are now separated to: 
[list]
[*] Trainer
[*] Weapons & Shields
[*] Armors & Accessories
[*] Consumables
[*] Mercenaries & Pets
[/list]
[*] Merchants that sell Equipment for your Inventory have a dark brown button
[*] Merchants that sell Actions for your Deck have a dark purple button
[*] Instant options like Resting in Inn & buying Provisions have both a cost in parenthesis & use a dark blue button
[*] Added a 'Minimize Town UI' button to make clearer that the Town UI can be minimized i.e to Access your Character Sheet (The Town Toggle button in the Combat Log already did that, but may not have been very obvious)
[/list]

[h1] New Action Effects & Properties [/h1]
[list]
[*] New Action Property: ExcludeFromRandomLoot:1, can be used to exclude an Action from Random Drops & Merchants i.e to make it a unique quest reward or craftable only through another card, event etc.
[*] New Action Effect (to use as a Summon Property)
[list]
[*] AllyAbility[Ability]:x, Override the Ally Special Command (Defend + Retribution), with this [Ability]
[*] Unlike the Default Command (Defend + Retribution), this custom special ability don't cost anything to your ally, but using it will deactivate them for the turn
[*] [Ability] can be any Card Effect. A temporary card will be created with this effect and target the first enemy. Player still receives any positive benefits.
[*] i.e AllyAbilityDamage:3, will create a 'card' with a base Damage Effect of 3 of the Ally's element. Then the Player's Bonuses in that element will apply and will use this 'card' automatically to the first enemy
[*] [Ability] can be a Card Name. A temporary card will be created with spellcraft [card name] and target the first enemy. Player will then receive the [card name] copy in hand.
[*] i.e AllyAbilityCharge:1, will create a "Charge" Card in player's hand
[*] The created card copy aside from [Ability] will also inherit any active synergies. i.e A synergy damage while activating a heal ability, will both heal the player & harm the first enemy.
[*] The first enemy (if exists) is the prefered target to avoid harming the player. However if there are no enemies in the battlefield the player will be targeted instead despite any harmful synergies.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes & Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] AdjustStatus[Counter Type] x, card text will display as: "Adjust [Status Name] counters in Target (if any) by +/-x"
[*] All Unique Allies are now excluded from Merchants & Random Loot Tables
[*] Added the ExcludeFromRandomLoot:1 flag in the following Actions (can't appear in Merchants or as Random Drops)
[list]
[*] Animist: Claw Attack, Wildshape
[*] Lycanthrope: Claw Strike, Feral Strike, Hybrid Form, Feral Werewolf
[*] Vampire: Progeny

[/list]
[*] Very few Allies will now offer the Defend/Retribution Special. Most changed to include more unique & interesting activated abilities.
[*] The following Summons (or cards related to Summons) have been changed to include alternative Special Abilities (or to become more suitable Special Abilities):
[list]
[*] Animist: Wall of Vines, Snake Nest, Animal Ally II, Tarantula, Woodland Dryad, Animal Ally III, Animal Ally IV, Oakfolk, Animal Ally V, The Ancient
[*] Blood Mage: Vigor Mortis, Raven Familiar, Blood Raven, Blood Elemental

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0223
notes.content:
Hi folks,

This build adds some community-requested features in the UI: 

a) You can now see a hand of 12 cards before the need to scroll. 
b) Negative effects (as well as the Echo actions that affect a specific enemy) will now appear as stacks under their portraits, instead of individual icons.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/19e4c8746ea2ff37f0c43ed41eb0d2f3fd23bc0f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/cb5efd6054970d4637c0de1394c05ab0ce2cb2b2.jpg[/img]

These changes affect many things under the hood, so let me know if you encounter any bugs or weird issues.

In addition to the UI changes there some new DoT-related Action effects for modders to use in their Actions. 

[h1] EA Build 0223 [/h1]

[h1] UI Changes & Improvements [/h1]
[list]
[*] Minor Card Template Change - Unified Card Info Button & Action Cost: You can click on the scroll behind Action Cost to view Card Details & Active Modification effects.
[*] Whenever you have more cards than can fit in the hand area (7+), Cards will shift closer to each other & up to 12 cards can now be viewed without the need to scroll
[*] Enemy Status effects appear as a stack instead as individual icons
[*] Echo Actions that are affecting an Enemy will Display both in the 'Actions in Effect' zone (as they are part of the Echo Chain) & also underneath the enemy portrait they affect to quickly identify the Action's target and to make clear that they exist as long as their target exists.
[list]
[*] Hovering over the icon of an Echo Action let's say 'Jinx', that is now under the Enemy portrait will display this help text: "Jinx (Echo Action), Jinx will keep affecting this Target each turn and be part of the Echo Chain; till it either Expires, is Replaced, or its Target dies. Only one Jinx Action can be active at any given time. Any new instance of Jinx will dispel & replace its older instance."
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] New DoT Counter Types & Action Effects [/h1]
[list]
[*] Venom x: [Gives Envenomed counters] Target loses 3 HP per Envenomed counter. (Non-Immune Enemies have a 25% chance to resist this effect.)
[*] Burn x: [Gives Burning counters] Target loses 5 HP per Burning counter. (Non-Immune Enemies have a 25% chance to resist this effect.)
[*] AdjustStatus[Counter Type] x: All counters of the chosen type in Target increase or decrease by x. If the Target doesn't have any counters of the chosen type, this effect is ignored.
[list]
[*] i.e AdjustStatusVulnerable:3, if the Target has any Vulnerable counter they increase by +3. if they previously had 1 they now have 4 etc.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] (Visual) Primal Damage increase wasn't reflected in the short card description
[*] Negative Status Effects could sometimes calculate as if having 1 counter less
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0222
notes.content:
Hi folks!

I am back from my vacation in Paros and reporting for duty! 

This small patch fixes all the bugs you reported in the forum during my five day absence - let me know if I forgot something - and also implements some minor balance changes based on your suggestions and your frustrations.

During the rest of the July, I will be improving the Adventure Mode, add several new Enemy AI responses and work on the game localization along with various items from the community wishlist. 

[h1] EA Build 0222 [/h1]

[h1] Bug fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] In certain cases the temporary copy would gain XP instead of the original card
[*] Card Info details (while modified by synergy) was showing in the modified card 0 level & 0 xp instead of the original card's level & xp
[*] In Adventure Mode: Purchasing Rations in Town wasn't updating (visually) the player's resources in the World map, and wasn't refreshing the eligible travel destinations
[*] There was a bug in the Random Discard algorithm causing biased discards
[*] Equipment could get discarded with some random discard effects when it shouldn't
[/list]

[h1] Balance Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] All characters start with a +1 in AP/Turn Regeneration Rate
[*] AP/Turn Regen Rate will now increase by +1 every Character Level
[*] Choosing & Discarding cards from your hand by dragging them to your backpack is now free. You can still manually set an HP cost on any Game Mode using the 'BackpackDiscardCost' property.
[/list]

[h1]QoL and Misc Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] AP/Turn Regen Rate will now display in both Character Creation & Character Sheet as 'AP/Turn' & during the Level Up info as 'New AP/Turn' as now it increases by +1 every character level.
[*] Discard effect text changed to 'Discard up to x Non-Equipment Card(s) at Random.' for more clarity
[*] When discarding a card, the discarded card name will also appear in the log under the message that you discarded x cards
[/list]
	
[h1] New Game Mode Property:  [/h1]
[list]
[*] "BackpackDiscardCost":-x, a negative value (or zero), representing the HP Cost to discard unwanted cards from your hand by dragging them to your backpack (vanilla value is now 0 disabled)
[*] To enable the old behavior of -2 HP cost: add this line in your game mode: "BackpackDiscardCost":-2
[/list]

[h1] Build 0222.1 - Refinements & Addentum [/h1]

[h1] Balance [/h1]
[list]
[*] Attributes below 10, now receive slightly harsher penalties (-1 for every point below 10 down to -5 at 5, i.e 8 is now -2. The lowest penalty was before -3)
[*] Initial Attributes can now manually increase up to 18 and only drop down to 8 (instead from 20 / 6). Racial adjustment can still drop an attribute below 8.
[*] AP/Turn Regen Rate will now increase by +1 every two Character Levels: at 2,4,6 etc. This bonus however is now bound into a game property and you can disable or change it as you see fit.
[*] Changed the level up message to 'AP/Turn:x' as now its possible not to gain any additional Regen rate at certain levels
[*] Slightly Modified the Base AP/Base HP ratio of all classes & races, so some classes/races will benefit more or less from the New AP regen rates.
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode Property: [/h1]
[list]
[*] "APRegenRateBonusPerLevel":x.x, a float value that is used as a multiplier for your level, when determinining the bonus AP/Turn gain on level up.
[list]
[*] i.e "APRegenRateBonusPerLevel":0 or undefined means that the level doesn't affect the AP/Turn.
[*] "APRegenRateBonusPerLevel":1.0 means that you gain +1 AP Regen / level. 
[*] "APRegenRateBonusPerLevel":0.5 means you gain +1 AP Regen every 2 levels etc. 
[*] "APRegenRateBonusPerLevel":0.2 means you gain +1 AP regen every 5 levels etc.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Note to Modders: [/h1] 
[list]
[*] All (playable) Races & Classes .json files has been modified - Base AP/HP ratios changed
[*] All (vanilla) Game Mode .json files now include a default "APRegenRateBonusPerLevel" value of 0.5
[/list]

[h1] Build 0222.2 - Game Mode Editor Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] 'APRegenRateBonusPerLevel' Game Mode property can be set via the Custom Game Mode Editor [Section: Player AP/Turn Regen Rate]
[*] 'BackpackDiscardCost' Game Mode property can be set via the Custom Game Mode Editor [Section: Choose & Discard Cards to Backpack]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0220
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

This build adds an additional Game Mode, that some of you have suggested a while back: Draft, and of course you can also convert any game mode to Draft (manually), with the new Game Mode property 'Draft'. 

To spice things up in the vanilla draft mode, I also set your Race/Class Combination to Changeling/Jack of all Trades. So even though the Changeling copies any attributes you set during character creation, you no longer count as a member of your former race & class, and you lose their starting deck, skills & perks.

On the bright side, as Changeling you have access to Vampire, Lycanthrope, Human & Demon cards and as Jack of all Trades you have access to Mercenary, Mystic, Hunter, Shadow, Animist, Exorcist, Witch & Necromancer cards.

So you can draft & create all sort of wacky decks from across 12 Disciplines!

At the end of each encounter you can choose what happens next (similar to the 'Puppeteer' mode.) So you can further draft cards if you need, visit the town to purchase specific cards, or fight your way to the boss.

Aside from the new Draft mode and the assorted game properties, I also made some (major) balance changes in the Enemy Database and the Enemy Level up Algorithm. 

This change (I hope) will provide you with a more challenging yet smoother difficulty curve in Ironman & its variants, while leaving the Casual & Normal Modes (mostly) untouched for the Casual Players who don't like min/maxing their characters but still want a fair share of challenge.

I am looking forward of course to hear your thoughts on these changes!
 
In the meantime have fun!

[h1] Balance Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the Enemy Level Ranges the player can meet [ from (SC - 2, SC + 1) to (SC - 1, SC + 2), where SC = Stages Cleared]
[*] Increased Normal Encounters in Normal from 2 to 4, to 3 to 4
[*] Increased Elite Encounters in Ironman from 3 to 4, to 3 to 5
[*] Increased Elite Lvl Difference in Puppeteer from +1 to +2, Elite Encounter from 3 to 5 to 4 to 5 & Enemy Health was set to 100%, Enemy Power to 90%
[*] Slightly changed the algorithm that generates higher level enemies: Increased HP & Power, Slightly higher positive resistances, Negative resistances (weaknesses) will no longer become worse.  
[*] Slightly reduced Damage Range of most Enemies, which along with their new level up algorithm should result in a smoother difficulty curve
[*] Several Enemy Races are now immune to the 'Kill' effect
[*] Cards Changed: Final Death (Hunter)
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode Properties [/h1]
[list]
[*] "ModeDescription": Display a plain text description of the Game Mode above rule modifications.
[*] "Draft": true or false, if true the player will open 12 Grimoires of 4 cards each and pick 12 cards.
[*] "ForceClass":"Class", if set will keep the customized attributes but change the player's class to the chosen class
[*] "ForceRace":"Race", if set will keep the customized attributes but change the player's race to the chosen race
[*] Forced Class & Race don't have to be a playable Classes or Races. As long as the class has a Starting Weapon Equipped you are good to go. (Deck, Skills & Perk can all be blank)
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode 'Draft' [/h1]
[list]
[*] Player's Race is set to 'Changeling' & Class is set to 'Jack of all Trades' 
[*] This combination offers no Deck, initial Skills or Perks but access to all Basic Race & Class Disciplines
[*] Upon game start the player must draft 12 cards to add to their deck
[*] The rest of the mode rules are Ironman with the Puppeteer event firing each time the node changes.
[*] You can create your own custom draft modes (manually) just add "Draft":true, to any game mode
[/list]

[h1] Misc QoL improvements [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a message in the combat log displaying the AP player restored at the start of their turn  
[*] Added a Codex Entry for the Card's Potential: "If a Card's Potential is lower than the Target's level, Negative effects like Stun, Vulnerable, Bewitch etc. won't affect them. A Card's Potential is = Your Level + Card Level + Empower Bonus."
[*] The Card's potential will now show in the Card Details accessible via the Card Info button
[*] Added text description in all vanilla game modes to better describe what they are about and who are aimed at
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Conditional & Contingency effects were not improving as the Card level increased
[*] Conditional, Contingency weren't counting as part of the card when calculating the damage necessary to break counters (i.e Bewitched, Frozen & Immobilized) 
[*] Some effects weren't counting as a damage source when calculating the damage necessary to break counters (i.e Bewitched, Frozen, Immobilized)
[*] Whenever counters were removed from an enemy ie. due to damage breaking immobilized, only 1 counter was removed instead of the x damage-depended counters
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0219
notes.content:
Hi folks,

This build introduces a very flexible Game Mode property which allows you (the modder) to hook any Event you like in the Change Node button (End of Turn without any enemies present).

To test it out, and for anyone who doesn't care in particular about modding, we also have a new Game Mode called 'Puppeteer'. 

What this mode does, is that it simply let's you choose your next node (among a list of choices) every time you are about to change your node.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/f3cecee633037d4117625dcf9979785eacc036bb.jpg[/img]

You want to fight an elite encounter? Camp? Look for a Random Event? You can choose exactly how the Stage will play out and follow your own Path to the Boss. Or just press 'space' to skip choosing & fight a normal encounter.

Now the thing to keep in mind with this mode (its vanilla implementation), is that even though it initially appears modded in your favor (less Enemy HP & Power, Starting at Level 3, free access to Camp & Towns) as long as there are less than 2 enemies, every 2 rounds, enemy reinforcements will arrive. So that's 3 more spawns to deal with. Which won't be as hard to deal in the first stages, but will get progressively harder later on and result in longer Encounters ;)

Of course, you are not only free to create your own 'Puppeteer' game modes, but to also attach any other event you like in this new Game Mode property. Perhaps just the option to Camp, or to Gather Herbs or any other activities you can think, you can probably mod it. 

Now while nothing should break in the main game (any other modes), this new game property (while active) changes the core functionality of the game loop, and it may still have issues I couldn't detect while testing. 

So let me know if you encounter any strange behaviors while playing the vanilla or your custom Puppeteer modes. And your thoughts on how to make this mode more exciting ;)

[h1] New (experimental) Game Mode 'Puppeteer' [/h1]
[list]
[*] Each time you are about to advance a Node the 'Puppeteer' Event is called instead
[*] This Event lets you choose your next node
[*] You can choose between a Normal Encounter, Elite Encounter, Random Event, Merchant Event, Camp, Town or to Draft a new Action
[*] Camp & Town both will cost you 1 Ration & have a 10% chance to trigger a random encounter after you arrive
[*] Draft allows you to pick up to 3 new Actions out of 12, but for each tome you wish to open you need to pay 2, 4 & 8 AP
[*] The last node can't be changed and is always the Boss
[*] Vanilla Puppeteer uses an easier variant of the Ironman mode with overall more but weaker enemies and a quite high reinforcements rate
[*] You can convert any game mode (including a Sandbox mode) to 'Puppeteer' by setting in the Game mode: "OnAdvanceNodeEvent":"Puppeteer"
[*] You can also customize the options in 'Puppeteer' Event by editing the Puppeteer.json event, or just provide your own OnAdvanceNodeEvent
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode Properties[/h1]
[list]
[*] "ReinforcementsToCall":x, The number of additional enemies to call as reinforcements. If unset (most vanilla modes) defaults to 1.
[*] "OnAdvanceNodeEvent":"EventID", If the player is about to advance a node, instead call EventID and don't advance the node.
[list]
[*] After this Event is called, the next time the player attempts to advance node they'll do so normally
[*] After the Player advance in node, the next time they attempt to advance node the OnAdvanceNodeEvent is called once more
[*] So what this does is changing the advance node behavior to alternate between calling this event and actually advancing the node
[*] OnAdvanceNodeEvent is disabled while exploring Dungeons, Caves or Bandit Camps
[*] When the 'Puppeteer' event is used as OnAdvanceNodeEvent all nodes become questionmarks.
[*] Both properties can only be set manually by editing the game mode .json files. You can find the Puppeteer.json in the Game Modes folder, and use it as a reference.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added scrolling in the Event Choices section
[*] Events can now have up to 12 Choices, but only the first 4 are visible without scrolling.
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Renaming the misspelled "Shutter Weapon" to "Shatter Weapon" in 0217.2 broke the Mercenary Skill List in the Character Sheet
[/list]

[h1] Build 0219.1 - Hotfix [/h1]
[list]
[*] While using Custom Stage Sets (in Puppeteer Mode), the length of the Stage was set incorrectly, teleport the player from mid-stage at the dungeon entry.
[/list]

[h1] Build 0219.2 - Hotfix/Addon [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed some typos in the 'Puppeteer' event
[*] Added a few presets for Reinforcements & OnAdvanceNodeEvent handlers in the Game Mode Editor
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0218 (Both Branches)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

With this build the last two original disciplines (Exorcist & Witch) also join the club of the revised card sets, which now includes all the races and the 8 original classes (Mercenary to Witch). 

I don't plan to revise the newer Classes (Death Knight to Runecaster) [b]at this point of time[/b], but instead just give them additional cards later in the development cycle.

For one the newer classes are already quite powerful and distinctive in ways the original classes weren't. I had access to a (significantly) larger pool of action effects when I created them, and they also (inevitably) already inherited plenty of the latest effects during this revision. [i]Aside from their own card sets most of the new classes use several relevant cards from other disciplines.[/i] 

So the plan for these classes is to just expand their own card sets with more actions. Then (and if necessary) revise anything that needs a revision.

This will happen a bit later down the road, as this revision cycle has impacted a huge amount of cards, and we (you and I) have already lot changes on our plate to test! Nothing is set to stone yet, so looking forward to hear your feedback. ;)

Last but not least, I'll be taking my vacation from 28 June to 5 July. Till then & when I come back I'll return my focus to the Events, the Adventure Mode and the Community Wishlist.

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0217 (Both Branches)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks, 

This patch concludes (for the time being) the new round of Action Effects additions. There are plenty of them and many are composite (which means you can combine them with non-composite keywords and create different effects) so lots of things to test and re-familiarize with. You can find them all together in the Community Modding Guide (Action Effects - Part 3).

Aside from the new effects there are many changes to be aware: 9 Disciplines got their initial makeover, I added an extra upgrade level for all cards, a new Card Tier (T6) for Modders to use, new game mode properties and an Enemy Reinforcement system, to keep you from abusing the upgrade system (the wrong way). You know you can just edit your save files right?

So many things to test & many things that can go wrong! I would highly recommend to start a new character if you are currently playing one of the revised classes/races, but it's not really necessary.

Looking forward for your feedback and let me know if you encounter any issues! Have fun!

[h1] Balance Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Non-Elite Enemy Encounter for Casual is set to 2 to 3 Enemies (was 1 to 3)
[*] Non-Elite Enemy Encounter for Normal is set to 2 to 4 Enemies (was 2 to 3)
[*] Revised/Boosted/Nerfed the following Card Sets (so much, you probably won't recognize them. Well not really. But you get the point) 
[*] Human, Vampire, Lycanthrope, Demon, Mercenary, Shadow, Mystic, Hunter, Animist got their initial makeover. All changes are still a subject for thorough play testing by both you & I. So nothing is finalized yet...
[/list]

[h1] Enemy Reinforcements [/h1]
[list]
[*] Every 3 turns and if there are less than 3 enemies in the battlefield a new enemy will now join the encounter (if such enemy can be found in the DB)
[*] A relevant message will appear in your Combat Log: "Oh no! Enemy Reinforcements!"
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode Properties [/h1]
[list]
[*]  "EnemyReinforcementsEveryXTurns":x, Every x turns the encounter lasts enemies of the same faction will join the combat 
[*]  "ReinforcementsIfEnemiesLessThan":x, Reinforcement will only be called if enemies are less than x
[*]  You can (manually) adjust both values in your game modes, if no values are set in either (all vanilla modes) both will default to 3
[*] If you want to disable the Reinforcements system set the x in "EnemyReinforcementsEveryXTurns":x very high i.e 30
[/list]

[h1] Card Tiers & Upgrades Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Support for Tier 6 cards (there aren't though any Tier 6 actions in the game)
[*] Maximum Card Level is now Tier + 1
[*] Equipment Reqs changed to Levels 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 & 11 (From 1,3,6,9,12)
[*] Tier 5 now unlocks at Mastery 90 & Tier 6 at 120
[*] Tier 0 can upgrade up to Level 1, Tier 1 up to Level 2 ... Tier 6 up to Level 7
[*] If after upgraded a card can still be upgraded, its dots (representing the card levels) will now glow purple
[*] Once a card reaches its maximum level it will get an extra dot and all of them will now glow in orange (like before)
[/list]

[h1] Contigency Action Triggers [/h1]
[list]
[*] If the Caster has more (or less) [Status] than x, this Action gains [Effect] y
[*] Notes to Modders:
[list]
[*] Similar to Conditional Action Triggers but they instead trigger based on the PC HP, AP & Level values. There is a simple two step declaration:
[*] OnCasterStatus[Status]:[x], ContigencyEffect[Effect]:[y]
[*] Caster Status can be HPLess, HPMore, HPOverHalf, HPBelowHalf, APLess, APMore, APOverHalf, APBelowHalf, LevelLess, LevelMore
[*] Caster Status can be [Attribute]More or [Attribute]Less ie. CharismaMore, ResilienceLess etc.
[*] Less/Below is true only if the checked value is less, while More/Over if the checked value is greater or equal
[*] i.e OnCasterStatusHPOverHalf:1, ContigencyEffectSacrifice:5 will add a Sacrifice Effect if Player's HP >= 50%
[*] i.e OnCasterStatusCharismaMore:20, ContigencyEffectLust:5 will add a Lust Effect if Player's Charisma is more than 20
[*] Only one contigency pair can be present in the card
[*] Unlike Conditional Action Triggers that only target Enemies, Contigency can additionally target the caster or an ally
[*] A (single) Conditional & a (single) Contigency Trigger can both be present in the same card
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Misc Quality of Life Improvements [/h1]
[list]
[*] Towns will now display Rations & Player's HP & AP
[*] The button to buy rations in town will deactivate if you have (or once you reach) the carry capacity of 4 Rations
[*] Whenever an active Synergy converts the optimal target to Enemy or Ally, all Cards in hand will change their 'Optimal Target' text to reflect that, but the color will remain intact to indicate that this a temporary change.
[*] Right clicking on a such modified 'self' card will properly target your enemy instead of you
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Bonus Effect from Conditional Action Trigger didn't have Element or Tier set. Now inherit that of the original Action
[*] Bonus Effect from Conditional Action Trigger was incurring Fatigue penalty, when it shouldn't
[*] Cards with Conditional Action Triggers weren't marked as 'Enemy', when they should
[/list]

[h1] Build 0217.1 - Hotfix [/h1]
[list]
[*] When was using the right click/double click method to use actions, a damaging synergy was active & Optimal Target text was temporarily set to 'Enemy', the action would be cast twice: once on its original target and once on the new target (first enemy)
[/list]

[h1] Build 0217.2 [/h1]

[h1] Balance Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Accessories & Armor no longer count toward Fatigue
[*] Slightly Reduced the AP Upkeep of the following Armor & Accessory (Loot) Cards: Reinforced Leather, Steel Breastplate, Emerald Orb, Unicorn's Horn, Ring of Firebolts, Dragon Signet, Eye of Mertazul, Living Ring, Golden Medallion, Bloodstone Talisman, Dragonclaw Talisman
[*] Further edited the following Actions:
[list]
[*] Human: Patch Wounds, Second Sight, Telekinetic Thrust
[*] Vampire: Fast Healing, Alacrity
[*] Lycanthrope: Animal Instinct, Supernatural Strength
[*] Hunter: Rapid Shot, Silver Coating, Venison, Unleash, Camouflage, Eagle Sight
[*] Mercenary: Powerful Thrust, Evasive Maneuver, Superior Physique, Pummel, Sudden Thrust, Overpower, Shatter Weapon
[*] Mystic: Mana Stone, Iceball, Frost Touch, Electric Surge, Mirror Image
[*] Shadow: Weak Poison, Curvet, Potent Poison, Shadow Vortex, Deadly Poison, Meld in Shadows
[*] Animist: Rejuvenation, Snake Nest, Ancestral Totem
[/list]
[*] Revised the Necromancer Card Set - Cards Changed:
[list]
[*] Apprentice Staff (N), Journeyman Staff (N), Master Staff (N), Necronomicon, Chill Touch, Empower Dead, Recycle, Skeletal Minion, Curse, Affliction, Funnel, Doom, Contagion, Skull Mask, Exhume, Drain Lifeforce, Necrotic Blast, Death Shield, Dark Conduit, Skeletal Warrior, Plague, Infection, Torpefy, Death Caress, Embrace Death, Dark Gift, Scent of Decay, Noxious Cloud, Death Knell, Syphon Soul, Undead Horror, Decompose, Desecration, Skeletal Army, Death Knight, Famine, Snuff Out, Call of the Damned
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] 'Contingency' Action Trigger Resolution Keyword was incorrectly spelled as 'Contigency'Effect[Effect]. Changed to the correct spelling: ContingencyEffect[Effect]:[y]
[*]  If you created any Mods using this keywords make sure to make a mass find & replace to the correct spelling ;)
[*] Shatter Weapon card was incorrectly spelled as "Shutter Weapon"
[*] If you have a Mercenary Save and are using or have used the card "Shatter Weapon" *your save won't work* unless you open it and replace any "Shutter Weapon" references with "Shatter Weapon"
[*] Fixed a few more typos and spelling errors
[*] There was certain cases were casting actions wouldn't count properly toward Fatigue (Concentration wasn't dropping)
[/list]

notes.title: EA Build 0216 - Development Branch
notes.content:
Hi folks,

This build doesn't have much to offer or to test unless you are a modder. So you can safely skip it. 

It introduces 2 new Keywords: Fury & Chaotic, and a way to Dispel all those pesky Enemy statuses - Dispel. It also includes a method to create simple conditional effects: If the Target has +x [Status] counters, this Action gains [Effect] y. 

For example if the Enemy has 2 Immobilized Counters perhaps the action can also deal an extra 5 Intense damage. Or if the Enemy has Counter Attack, boost your Defend buff, Or if they are Frozen add a chance to Kill them etc. 

Even though all the enemy Statuses can be combined with all the Action keywords that aren't composite, doesn't mean that all such combinations make sense. So use this new possibility as you see fit.

I'll do some further tests on all new Actions effects, and add some new actions we can play with  tomorrow. If you use them in your mods and have any issues let me know ;)

[h1] New Action Keywords[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fury:x, Create and use on Target x individual copies of this Action. Each copy triggers separately and in order, but you pay the Action cost only once.
[list]
[*] The Fury effect will only trigger when targeting an Enemy and as long as this enemy is still alive
[/list]
[*] Chaotic:x, Deals x/2 to x [Card Type] Damage to a Random Enemy (Including Flying Enemies)
[*] Notes to Modders:
[list]
[*] Chaotic deals a [Card Type] Damage as such will benefit from Amplify, Affinity or any Perks modifying those
[*] Chaotic can harm Flying Enemies even if the Card isn't Ranged
[*] Modifications in the 'Damage Effect' (like from Bellicose or Cautious Perks) only modify the 'Damage Effect', so if you want to include 'Chaotic' you need to explicitly do so.
[*] All vanilla perks that Modify Damage have been altered to also Modify Chaotic (to avoid confusion)
[*] i.e Bellicose is now defined: ModifyEffectDamage:1, ModifyEffectChaotic:1, ModifyEffectDefend:-1
[*] So in all cases any vanilla card with both Damage & Chaotic should display and deal the exact same range of damage
[*] If both Damage & Chaotic effect is present in the same card, both will split or benefit from Double, Triple, Quad & both will benefit from Amplify Bonus & reduce it.
[*] The Chaotic effect doesn't require an explicit target, so won't mark cards having it as 'Enemy'. It can be part of self, ally or armor cards and still harm the enemies similar to Pride & Lust.
[/list]
[*] Dispel[Status]:x, Target loses up to x [Status] counters. 
[list]
[*] In order to Dispel a status your [Level + Card Level + Empower] must be higher/equal than [Enemy Level + 3]
[*] Notes to Modders: Not all effects really make sense to dispel, especially those you inflicted, but still you can use this keyword to dispel any status except "Dispel"
[*] There is a list with all the available statuses in 0216 build below
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Conditional Action Triggers [/h1]
[list]
[*] A bonus effect can be added to the action depending on the target enemy status
[*] If the Target has +x [Status] counters, this Action gains [Effect] y.
[*] i.e If the Target has +2 Vulnerable counters, this Action gains Bleed 1.
[*] i.e If the Target has +3 Immobilized counters, this Action gains Kill 100.
[*] Notes to Modders:
[list]
[*] The Triggers are build to work for any present and future Status & Keyword. There is a simple two step declaration:
[*] OnEnemyStatus[Status]:x, AddEffect[Effect]:y
[*] Only one such pair can be added in a single action
[*] ie. OnEnemyStatusVulnerable:2, AddEffectBleed:1, Actions:1, Tier:1, Element:Piercing
[*] ie. OnEnemyStatusImmobilized:1, AddEffectVulnerable:2, Actions:1, Tier:1, Element:Piercing
[*] AddEffect accepts any numerical keyword that isn't already composite keyword. i.e You can't do AddEffectSynergyBleed:1, as SynergyBleed is already a composite keyword.
[*] For now the Added effect triggers individually so you can't add an effect that acts as a modifier ('Double' or 'Chain' for example both need a Damage source). But you can use any stand alone effect.
[*] OnEnemyStatus accepts any enemy status that uses counters to apply: Immobilized, Entangled, Frozen, Bleeding, Bewitched, Weaken, Vulnerable, Doom, Poison, Defensive Stance, Spiked Armor, Counter Attack, Warcry, Rage, Empower, Healing, Hex, Concealment, Incorporeal, Regenerate, Gallop, Flying, Feed, Hybrid Form, Animal Ally, Illusory Copy, Dispel
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Killing Enemies with the 'Pride' or 'Lust' effects wouldn't trigger the Explode effect
[/list]

notes.title: EA Build 0215 - Development Branch
notes.content:
Hi folks,

This build implements 4 new Action Keywords: Cursed, Fleeting, Mutate & Unravel, and  1 new Keyword modifier that can affect every keyword in the game: Teamwork. 

You can read below their exact rules or wait till they are added to various old and new cards alike in the coming builds. If you are a Modder you can start using those keywords in your own cards right away.

I also updated several codex entries to include the changes from the previous Actions Revision and make clearer what they do.

[h1] Updated Codex Entries [/h1]
[list]
[*] Several Terms Codex entries updated to included any relevant (revision 2 & revision 3) rule changes (their detailed - on hover text remains unchanged)
[*] Bewitch, Stun & Freeze Addentum: "When damaging an Immobilized, Frozen or Bewitched Target, 1 counter breaks for every 3 damage dealt (above 3). ie 1 counter if dealt 3-5 damage, 2 counters if dealt at 6-8 damage etc. If the card both deals damage and inflicts the status the damage required to remove a counter increases by +3."
[*] AoE Addentum: "Cards with AoE simply deal x damage to all enemies, all other effects apply to originating target. This effect is deprecated instead use Multicast."
[*] Concealment Addentum: "Concealment breaks if used in Sneak Attack or after you all your enemies have acted."
[*] Empower codex entry will now read: "Empower x: Action effects improve relative to x while the effect is active. Empower drops by 25% each time its bonus is used (down to 2), unless the Card using it also includes it. Additionally the Empower bonus will drop by -1 every end of turn and while the encounter lasts."
[*] Amplify codex entry will now read: "Amplify [Damage Type] x: This turn all your Actions that deal [Damage Type] damage, deal +x damage. Amplify bonus is reduced by 25% (down to 1) each time it boosts the Damage of a [Damage Type] Card, unless the Card using it also includes it. "
[*] Multicast All entry will now read: "Create a copy of the Multicast card for each enemy in the battlefield, and target them (play a copy in them) according the order they appear. (You can Drag & Drop enemies to rearrange them to a different order.)"
[*] Multicast x entry will now read: "Create a copy of the Multicast card for each of the first x enemies in the battlefield, and target them (play a copy in them) according the order they appear. (You can Drag & Drop enemies to rearrange them to a different order.)"
[*] Split codex entry will now read: "Split [Damage Type]: 50% of the Card's Damage converts to the new [Damage Type]. Splitting a card into the same [Damage Type] will make any resistant enemies to it 2x times more resistant, and weak enemies 2x times weaker."
[*] Imbue codex entry will now read: "Imbue [Damage Type]: 50% of all the Damage you deal this turn converts to the new [Damage Type]. Splitting a card into the same [Damage Type] will make any resistant enemies to it 2x times more resistant, and weak enemies 2x times weaker."
[*] Discard codex entry Addentum: "Equipment can't be discarded with this effect & is skipped when counting cards to Discard."
[/list]

[h1] New Actions Effects [/h1]
[list]
[*] New Action Keywords (EoT Triggers)
[list]
[*] EoT Triggers: Their effect triggers, if the card having this effect is still in your hand as you end your turn.
[*] All EoT Triggers will trigger, immediately after the custom Discard phase & before any Echo Actions trigger in the following order:
[*] Cursed:x, If a card with this effect is in your Hand when you End your Turn: Lose x HP & Discard up to x Card(s) at Random. If more than one Cursed cards are in Hand, their Discard values will stack and Discard will trigger after all End of Turn triggers have been processed.
[*] Mutate[Card Name]:x,  If a card with this effect is in your Hand when you End your Turn: Discard it, then Create and Draw x [Card Name] copies. Mutate will trigger after a custom Discard phase (if any), but before any Discards caused due to Cursed cards.
[*] Unravel:x, If a card with this effect is in your Hand when you End your Turn: Discard it. You gain (or lose) x AP.
[*] Fleeting:1, If a card with this effect is in your Hand when you End your Turn: Discard all cards with the same name from your Hand & Drawpile.
[*] Cards with Cursed, Unravel or Fleeting cannot be manually discarded (via Drag & Drop to Backpack) a message will display instead in the Combat Log: "You can't choose to discard cards with the 'Cursed', 'Unravel' or 'Fleeting' effects."
[*] Note to Modders: 
[*] There isn't much point using EoT triggers in Equipment that doesn't go to your hand (like Armors & Accessories)
[*] You can use EoT triggers in Weapon & Offhand Equipment, but keep in mind that they won't discard as part of the EoT Trigger effect, and that they automatically return at the player's hand every turn.
[/list]
[*] New Keyword Modifier: Teamwork[Effect]:x
[list]
[*] Teamwork is a more demanding version of Synergy that also requires the presence of an active ally and needs to actually target an ally to work
[*] Teamwork [Effect] x: Exhaust an Active Ally. If you do, the next Action you play this turn gains Synergy [Effect] x + Ally Level.
[*] Teamwork effect will only trigger if an active ally is targeted. The ally will then get exhausted and the Synergy Modification will become active.
[*] All Allies can gain xp & level up, but it's very tricky for non-unique allies to actually do so due to their temporary nature
[*] Note to Modders: [Effect] can be any numerical based keyword except 'Synergy' & 'Echo'
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: EA Build 0214 (Both Branches)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

Along with the addition of the new events, during June I'll be also working on the 3rd (and probably final for the EA) Actions Revision. This will include a couple of rule changes here and there, new Action Keywords, a few more new Actions for every class & race as well as boosting (or nerfing) existing actions. 

The 'balance' I am aiming for isn't to make all the classes and races the same boring copy of each other. But instead retain their diversity and power level differences similar to the PnP RPG classes: A Vampire & a Human for example can never be equal or have the same survival chances against all odds. Each has each own merits and weaknesses. But we'd still pick one or the other because that's how we enjoy to play the game, and same goes with the classes. Also each has a different power level curve. Some start weak but become stronger, others starts strong but grow further at a slower pace, or simply appear to be weaker till you discover other potential merits or uses for them.

Having said that, I still want you to have all the necessary tactical options and means to survive with your archetype of choice, even when they are at their weakest. And also to eliminate any 'totally' useless cards (that is cards that are always useless under most circumstances) as much possible. Without of course turning every card into a swish army knife.

So if you have any actions in mind that you feel you never use, because they are way too weak, or way too specialized etc. Feel free to drop by the forum and let me know.

[h1] 'Echo' Keyword Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] When casting an Echo Action with the same name, instead of applying only the effects and leaving the original target & duration intact, the newest echo action will now replace the oldest's target and duration.
[*] Updated the Echo Codex entry with the following Addentum: "If you use an Echo Action that shares a name with one already in effect, the newest Action replaces the oldest."
[/list]

[h1] 'AoE' Keyword is now deprecated [/h1]
[list]
[*] All actions that were using the AoE effect (deal x damage to all enemies), now use Multicast x or Multicast All
[*] Some reminders on how the Multicast effect works:
[list]
[*] Multicast creates x instances of the Action, and you use them in succession in the x first targets (or all) but in the order they appear in the battlefield
[*] You can drag and drop enemies to change their order, and as result which enemies your multicast action targets
[*] All and any effects in the card (both negative and positive) trigger once for each enemy. 
[*] i.e Healing +5 in a Multicast 3 Action can give you up to 15 HP back but the same is true for -5 Healing action
[*] Even though you reap the benefits of a card multiple times, you only pay its action cost once
[*] With the new Echo rules: Multicasted Echo actions will now anchor to the last target instead of the first (Echo dispels if the last enemy ends up dying)
[*] Active Synergy will inject in all x copies.
[*] If the Multicast action provides Synergy, the second copy will benefit from it, and provide its own synergy to the third copy etc.
[*] If you still have any questions feel free to ask ;)
[*] AoE effect is still working & will remain for backward compatibility with your mods, but it's recommended to switch your action set to instead use Multicast
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Echo Actions (that shouldn't) dispel were dispeling along, with any actions following them that should dispel (i.e target destroy or otherwise expired) on their own
[*] Fixed a typo in Animist's Wildshape effect text causing tooltip formatting issues in the card 'Wildshape'
[*] Card Info button was still active even when the entire card was disabled ie. due to not having enough AP to use it.
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Classes & Races with Gender Restrictions will now state so in their codex entry
[*] New Event
[/list]


[h1] Modding Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Reward fields additions
[*] [New] EncounterFaction:[Faction or Race], can be used to generate a random encounter of the chosen faction or race
[list]
[*] i.e EncounterFaction:Ordo Tenebris, will generate a random encounter with enemies from the Ordo Tenebris faction
[*] i.e EncounterFaction:Undead, will generate a random encounter with enemies from the Undead race
[*] In both cases suitable enemies should exist in the Enemy DB, otherwise nothing will happen
[/list]
[*] [New] Hours:[x], Days:[x] will advance game time by x days or hours
[/list]

notes.title: EA Build 0212 - Both Branches
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/c6058b88241235dab4ad4a9bf20602cc30ba6995.jpg[/img]

Hello folks,

If you are following the Main Branch (Build 0205), this build adds a gazillion of new things including an Adventure Mode (Sandbox) and new Equipment types (Armors & Accessories).

(To get more help on the Armors & Accessories click on the ? icon on the Equipment tab as it includes updated information on how they work, and of course feel free to ask in the forum if things are still unclear.)

The Sandbox mode still needs lots and lots of events but doesn't seem to have any bugs or issues. And it's about time the branches to merge as I need you all on the same page and the builds you missed contain, well a gazillion of new things. 

So if you encounter any bugs or issues let me know. And if you have any event ideas you want me to include in the game, speak your mind! You are more than welcome to. :)

For the couple next builds I'll be mostly adding events and the assorted support for modders to build their own.

I highly recommend to check out the changelogs on any builds you might missed (if any) and drop by the forum if you have any questions.

[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1055990/announcements/detail/1590247263318747764] EA Build 0206 - Development Branch [/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1055990/announcements/detail/1587996099248745428] Sandbox Mode Preview [/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1055990/announcements/detail/1587996099259686822] The Sandbox Mode is now live in the Development Branch [/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1055990/announcements/detail/1587996099264551097] EA Build 0211 - Development Branch[/url]
[/list]

[b]The patch notes below are exclusively for Build 0212, which merges once more both branches[/b]

[h1] Misc QoL Improvements & Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Misc Tutorial additions & improvements
[*] Added help sections in Character Sheet for resistances, affinities & disciplines
[*] When looking up cards in the Terms Codex will also tell you which element the card belongs
[*] Card Template changes
[*] Replaced the Card Discipline with a Details button
[*] Card Discipline moved as a subtle watermark behind the card text
[*] Clicking on this button will display the detailed card rules in the Combat Log
[*] If any Synergy is active it will also display the card rules modified by the current active synergy

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/9e4e2fcc7104e0b1f678a2a5b7ae96f6b31b3619.jpg[/img]

[*] Improved Level up Notifications
[*] Added a notification above the character's portrait when nearing level up [(XP >= 40 * Level) That's 10 XP before Level 2 but 100 XP to Level 11], so plenty of heads up time if you want to spend your XP in perks. ;)
[*] Added a notification above the character's portrait when they gained a level and while their XP is still 0.
[*] Clicking on this banner will open the character sheet in Perks view.
[*] Added a more prominent section in the Log with info on how much HP & AP you gained & restored when the level was gained.
[*] [New] Hourglass button in Sandbox mode
[*] Clicking it will display your current location, area and date & time
[*] Additionally if no enemies are around, the 'Explore' event will be called (not to be confused with the function) (Modders: You can replace this event with something else ;)
[*] Explore event can be triggered only once per node (but not while in Headquarters). Once it does the button locks and will unlock again in the next node.
[*] If you are in an Event/Camp or Merchant node, and you also want to Explore, you can close the existing event with 'x' or just click on the 'Hourglass' button to replace it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/9cf2d41a49c474ad157d1b5cae767e3856fe0f0e.jpg[/img]

[*] Once the explore event opens currently player has two choices + to leave (advance node)
[*] Player can set a camp (A ration is always required here unlike the Camp node & also has 10% chance for random encounter)
[*] Player can spend 10 AP to explore some more (20% chance to trigger a random event or loot opportunity, 80% chance to just lose your precious AP)
[/list]

[h1] Modding Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Reward fields additions
[list]
[*] [New] SetHP:[Amount], SetAP:[Amount], will set HP & AP at the exact specified amount. (useful for a puzzle mode style event)
[*] [New] Discard:[x], player will discard x cards at random (except their equipment). (useful for a puzzle mode style event)
[*] [Improved] NextNode:[node], if there isn't any next node to change, ie. player is already on the final node of the stage, a new node will be created
[*] [New] Loot:[Card name] 
[*] ie. Loot:Skeletal Knight, will add the Action card in player's Deck instead of their Hand.
[*] ie. Loot:Apprentice Staff (N), will add the Equipment card in player's Inventory instead of their Hand
[/list]
[*] Requirements fields additions
[list]
[*] [New] Rations:[Amount], check if the player has the necessary rations.
[*] [New] HP:[Amount], AP:[Amount] & XP:[Amount], will succeed if Player's AP, HP & XP are more/or equal than amount
[/list]
[*] New Modder-exposed Function:
[list]
[*] [New] "RandomEvent": Will trigger a random event, similar to visiting the questionmark node.
[*] [New] "Explore": Has a 10% chance to trigger a random event, otherwise nothing happens
[/list]
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: EA Build 0211 - Development Branch
notes.content:
[h1] Important Rule Change [/h1]
[list]
[*] Perks that give negative bonuses i.e Damage -1, can no longer drop a card effect to 0, but down to 1. (Same with positive bonuses on negative values)
[*] All other bonuses are applied after the perk bonus/penalties. Perks affecting effects, affect the card base values. So a -1 Perk Penalty could completely remove an effect with a base value of 1. 
[*] That wasn't really a bug, but a probable source of confusion and frustration.
[*] Now such penalties are milder and in certain cases more potent as they can't drop base values below 1. 
[*] i.e let's say we have a perk that gives Damage -1. And two cards a) has base damage 1 and b) has base damage 2.
[list]
[*] a) Before 1-1 = 0. Effect is gone. No affinity bonus apply. Now 1-1 = 1. Effect still here. Affinity bonus apply. Negative perk effect is completely ignored.
[*] b) Before 2-1 = 1. Affinity bonus apply. Now 2-1 = 1. Affinity bonus apply. Negative perk effect apply normally. etc.
[/list]
[*] i.e let's say we have a perk that gives Healing +2. And two card a) has base healing -2 and b) has base healing -3.
[list]
[*] a) Before 2-2 = 0. Effect is gone. No empower bonus will apply. Now 2-2 = 1. Effect still here. Empower bonus apply. Positive perk is more potent.
[*] b) Before 2-3 = -1. Empower bonus apply. Now 2-3 = -1. etc.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes & Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 3 New Events, Added a feeding opportunity for Vamps at the Sleeping Merchant.
[*] Added 19 Herb Cards (can be found only in 'Forest' environment during the Gather Herbs event. Reqs 14 & 18 Intellect, as there isn't yet a gather herbs skill)
[*] Event Nodes in non-Sandbox environments have the same as before 4/6 chance to pick a looting opportunity instead of a random event.
[*] Event Nodes in Sandbox environments have a 4/12 chance to pick a looting opportunity instead of a random event.  Random Event can still be a looting opportunity (final odds are related to the event variety in the Tales DB, which right now doesn't have much)
[*] Backpacks will now only generate 2 items, instead of 2 to 4.
[/list]

[h1] Modding Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Requirements fields can now check for a particular environment, location and/or area
[*] [New] "Environment:[Environment Type]"
[*] [New] "Location:[Location Name]"
[*] [New] "Area:[Area Name]"
[list]
[*] ie. "Environment:Dungeon", in event or (event choice) will only show up if the player is in a Dungeon.
[*] ie. "Location:Lucina, Area:McMagnus Cove", in event or (event choice) will only show up if the player is adventuring in 'Lucina' and in particular at 'McMagnus Cove'.
[/list]
[*] All Requirements can now act as their reverse by prepending 'Not:' 
[list]
[*] i.e Not:Class:Shadow, will pass the check only if the player isn't a Shadow.
[/list]
[*] Requirement field in a 'Tale' object can now be used for both Unique & non Unique instances.
[list]
[*] If the Requirements of a unique event aren't met it will fall back into a random non-unique event.
[*] If the Requirements of a non-unique event aren't met it will fall back into the adventurer corpse looting scenario.
[/list]
[*] Rewards field additions:
[list]
[*] [New] 'RemoveChoice:All', Once the choice picked will remove all other choices from the player except onwards. Useful when you want the player to only pick one choice.
[*] i.e Pick the Lock or Bash the Lock? Save the merchant guards from bandits or join the bandits vs the guards? etc.
[*] [New] 'Invoke:[Discipline]', will create a random card copy from the chosen discipline, which can be of any tier or type so handle carefully
[*] Equipment summoned this way has to be used this turn, otherwise it'll get discarded at EOT.
[*] i.e Invoke:Loot, will create random loot card copy.
[*] But I mainly create this to be used in Events to gather herbs, fish etc.
[*] i.e assuming you have a Herbs card type (Vanilla DB now contains 19 Herbs) you could then do: Invoke:Herbs, to get a random card from that category.
[/list]
[*] Modder-Exposed Functions  (changes & additions)
[list]
[*] [Changed] 'Backpack' function generates 2 lootable items (Previously was 2 to 4). 
[*] [New] 'BrokenChest' function: will generate 1 to 2 lootable items.
[*] 'Chest' function is unchanged and will still generate 2 to 4 lootable items. But neither of the three (Backpack, Chest or BrokenChest) mentions anywhere what container player looted, so you can use any of them for any lootable container.
[*] [New] 'Feed' function: Vampire characters can feed to restore 15 AP & 10 HP in the process.
[/list]
[/list]


[h1] EA Build 0211.1 [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new Events
[*] Any 'rewards' that are a choice result will now append in the story instead of the combat log. i.e when finding farthings in a pouch, buying rations, resting in camps, getting card copies as a result of a choice etc.
