[*] Further increased the chances to poll a random event instead of a loot opportunity in Sandbox mode. Chances now depend solely on the Tales DB variety.
[*] 'Not:' modifier in Requirements was not working as intended 
[*] Requirements fields can now check if the player has enough Farthings
[list]
[*] [New] "Farthings:[Amount]", i.e Farthing:50, will return true if the player has 50+ Farthings
[/list]
[*] Reward fields can now give directly as reward: AP, HP, XP, Farthings & Rations (without relying on special function or creating new perks)
[list]
[*] [New] 'RemoveChoice:This', Will remove the current choice, not allowing to be picked twice. Executing most functions already include this behavior, so this is useful when you don't want to execute a function.
[*] [New] Farthings:[Amount], i.e Farthings:-30, will take 30 Farthings from Player
[*] [New] Rations:[Amount], i.e Rations:2, will give 2 rations to the Player
[*] [New] HP:[Amount], AP:[Amount] & XP:[Amount], will directly increase or decrease Player's AP, HP & XP
[/list]
[*] Modder-Exposed Functions  (changes & additions)
[list]
[*] 'Store:[Discipline]', will open a merchant inventory with cards from that discipline
[*] ie. "Store:Herbs", will open a Herbalist's inventory.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: The Sandbox Mode is now live in the Development Branch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

[h1] EA Build 0210 (Development Branch) [/h1]

We already talked briefly about what to expect from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1055990/announcements/detail/1587996099248745428] Sandbox mode [/url], so I'll just remind you that this initial implementation includes only procedural generated content (so no new events or stories yet), but you now have all the modding tools to start adding your own areas & content in the world.

To start your Sandbox adventure, just choose the game mode 'Adventure' from the game modes list.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/01cb9c38643f4331a8d3f72b6ebbae0f9cfc2039.jpg[/img]

All area name tags are clickable, but in order to choose an activity or travel you have to click on the name tag of your current location (Grysbog) or the big button in the top of the map: Explore - [Current Location].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/c6058b88241235dab4ad4a9bf20602cc30ba6995.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/3606ae61dfe378f4f7860a6f61ae3108e1bf64f0.jpg[/img]

You can also create your own Sandbox mode rules in the 'Custom Mode Game Editor' if you find the vanilla Sandbox too hard or too easy.

The 0210 Build also includes lots of changes unrelated to the Sandbox mode.  Most notable changes being 'Environment' specific enemies, 80 new Enemies, Enemy Compendium filters, Boss Generals, Towns Nerf and more... So make sure to check out the Patch notes below. 


[b]Without further ado, have fun![/b] 

(And of course if you have any questions feel free to ask!)

[h1] Sandbox Map Interactions & Game Loop Rules[/h1]
[list]
[*] Initial Travel and Exploration UI implementation.
[*] To explore or travel click on the large Explore - [Current Location] button, or click on the current location on the Map.
[*] The current location has a horse token next to it to indicate you are currently there.
[*] Clicking on any other location will show all its activities and travel options but disabled.
[*] There is a Map button in the Combat Log to switch between Map & Character view while in Map Mode only (ie. if player wants to examine their character sheet)
[*] Hard areas are marked in a red color while Easy areas in a green color (Relative to player level). 
[*] Normal difficulty areas and travel options will display in white.
[*] Unique and End Game areas will display the respective label in front of the area.
[*] Once an activity is chosen player moves into the proper area and map functionality is disabled till the quest or exploration is over
[*] Sandbox Areas don't necessarily need a boss at the end of stage, and the activity is completed oncle the last node is reached.
[*] Once an activity is completed player returns back to the world map
[*] Save will resume either in map or in the middle of the current activity, depending what the player was up to when the game last saved.
[/list]

[h1] Initial Calendar Implementation with Day & Night Cycle [/h1]
[list]
[*] The year in Erannorth has 360 Days and 12 Months of 30 Days each: Algor, Beltazoran, Serpentis, Drekkal, Elorian, Erannos, Myrkaz, Ertak, Heliosar, Myrestian, Whoozhu, Kanthar.
[*] Each week has 7 Days comprised by 24 hours: Moonhal, Dueshal, Wanehal, Thaurhal, Fryehal, Satyrhal, Sunhal.
[*] To simplify things: Sunset is always some time between 19:00 to 19:59 and Sunrise between 6:00 to 6:59.
[*] Whenever Travelling, time advances by the Days amount mentioned + (0 to 8h).
[*] Whenever exploring an area Node, time advances by 1 hour.
[*] Whenever camping, time advances by 8 hours.
[*] (Time of the day and years spend exploring will have impact in future builds)
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes & Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a note in Attributes codex entry that 'Hand size can never exceeed 7 regardless of Intellect bonus or Perk Benefits'
[*] When defining enemies, their "Environment" can also be set. If not it's set automatically to "Any" and they can appear anywhere
[*] Enemies with a specific "Environment" setting can only appear in that Environment (unless they are part of a Boss' retinue)
[*] "Environment" correspond to the current vanilla graphic sets: [Ice Cave, Bandit Camp, Dungeon, Infernal Cave, Marsh, Forest(includes Meadow & Plains), Beach, Arid (includes Arid Plains Camp, Arid Plains Shrine, Arid Plains), Tundra (includes Snowcovered Forest, Snowcovered Ruins)  & Arctic (includes Frozen Lake) in either sandbox or non-sandbox modes. i.e for a Sea Crab, Environment:Beach will make it only appear in Beach Environments but nowhere else.
[*] More than half of the Enemies are now Environment specific (Unclassified enemies can be found in "Any" environment)
[*] Enemy Environment, Damage & Health will now display when inspecting encountered enemies or looking them up in the Terms Codex, but not in Enemy Compendium.
[*] Added 80 new Enemies
[*] Enemy Gallery now includes filters to filter enemies by race or by class (Filter area is scrollable)
[*] Bosses can now have up to two normal enemies of their faction as their generals and may no longer fight you alone (if suitable enemies from their faction exist).
[*] Boss cycle now includes Eldanoth the Reborn (D8).
[*] Vanilla Ironman increased to 9 Stages.
[*] Added option to create Sandbox Game Modes in Game Mode Editor (under "How many stages to complete the run" => "Adventure Mode Sandbox").
[*] Towns Merchandise Tier in non-Sandbox modes is now equal to the Cleared Stage for Equipment (Min 0) & Actions (Min 1) instead of Cleared Stage + 1. 
[*] i.e At Stage 1 that's Tier 0 for Equipment (Previously was 1) & Tier 1 for Actions (Previously was 1). 
[*] i.e At Stage 2 that's Tier 1 for Equipment (Previously was 2) & Tier 1 for Actions (Previously was 2).
[*] Merchandise Tiers in each Sandbox settlement is defined by the 'AvailableActionTier' value)
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] When ending turn with [Space] Combat Log would automatically minimize
[*] Custom user Events wasn't displaying the custom Artwork
[*] The custom class icon wasn't displaying, when a custom enemy had a custom class
[*] An Intellect penalty would negate the Handsize bonus from perks, whereas it should apply despite any penalties
[/list]

[h1] Modding the Sandbox Mode [/h1]

[h1] New Game Property: Sandbox [/h1]
[list]
[*] Any Game Mode can turned into Sandbox, but it's recommended to set Endless:true. 
[*] All Stage related settings (like Custom Stage Sets, Starting Stage etc...) are overriden by the Location json files so won't have any effect
[*] But you can set about everything else: enemy related properties, all pc related properties, custom rules etc.
[*] Added option to create Sandbox Game Modes in Game Mode Editor (under "How many stages to complete the run" => "Adventure Mode Sandbox")
[/list]

[h1] Locations [/h1]
[list]
[*] Game modes will automatically use any defined locations if "Sandbox" mode is true
[*] Each Map Location contents and properties are moddable through their location.json files but their spot in the map, ID & Location name can't be altered
[*] It's not currently possible to add new locations in the map, only areas within the existing locations
[*] For instance You can't change Lanmerih's position (or name) in the map, but you can create your own areas in Lanmerih and/or edit any existing ones.
[*] Each location can have up to 10 Areas. Areas are like Stages but have some additional (moddable) properties 
[*] Location .json files are located in ../Content/Locations or ../Mods/[Your Mod]/Locations
[/list]

[h1] Modding the Location Properties [/h1]
[list]
[*] LocationName & ID: should be left as is, eitherwise vanilla locations won't work
[*] IsStartingLocation:true or false. Only one should be set as true. Make this Location the initial player location.
[*] TravelDestinations [Destination]:[Means]:[Days] i.e "Grysbog:Land:2", Define which are travel destinations from our location, by which mean (Land or Sea), and how many days it will take. Traveling by land consumes Rations at the rate of 1 every 2 days. Traveling by sea consumes Farthings at the rate of 10 Farthing / every day of the trip.
[*] HasTown: true or false. Determine whether the location has a settlement or not
[*] TownName: [Town name]. The settlement name, doesn't have to match the location
[*] AvailableActionTier: [Tier]. What actions tier can be found in Town, in turn also declares the settlement size (0-6)
[*] Each location can have 10 different areas. Each area can have each own Stage either procedurally generated or with custom nodes. x Below can be for every field a number between 1 to 10. i.e x => 1 to declare the first area etc.
[*] Area_x_GraphicSet: For now use one of the vanilla Stage Graphics Sets [Ice Cave, Bandit Camp, Dungeon, Infernal Cave, Meadow, Marsh, Plains, Beach, Arid Plains Camp, Arid Plains Shrine, Arid Plains, Snowcovered Forest, Snowcovered Ruins, Frozen Lake]
[*] Area_x_Name: The name of the area
[*] Area_x_isProcedural: true or false. Determine if the area is procedural or custom. Procedural stages never include a town node & may or may not include a boss as defined by Area_x_CompleteRequirements below.
[*] Area_x_Length: If the area is procedural how many nodes it have?
[*] Area_x_UnlockRequirements: a comma delimited Requirements string for the Area to show up. (Same options with the Tales System requirements) i.e Level:5, Class:Vampire. Area will be only available to level 5 vampire characters.
[*] Area_x_CompleteRequirements: requirements to complete (a procedural stage). Can be "Boss", "Endgame" or "". If it's "" the stage won't generate a Boss at the final node. If it's 'Endgame' completing this stage will end/conclude the sandbox mode. "Endgame" setting in procedural stages will always spawn a Boss, but you can also use it non-procedural stages in case you want something like an 'Epilogue'.At that point any bonus mastery & token rewards declared in the game mode are also awarded.
[*] Area_x_isRepeatable: true or false. Whether are is repeatable or an one off adventure.
[*] Area_x_MinEnemyTier: Min Enemy Tier
[*] Area_x_MaxEnemyTier: Max Enemy Tier
[*] The Base Enemy Max Level will be set temporarily to a value in between Min & Max Tiers. i.e 3 to 6, may set enemy Max level to 4 and the Boss to D4. Normal Enemies will then be level 1-4 while exploring this area. Next time you visit the same area can be different ie 1-3 and the Boss D3. etc.
[*] Area_x_Nodes: A list of your custom nodes if the stage is not procedural. (Similar to how you declare stage nodes in Custom Stage Sets.)
[/list]

[h1] EA Build 0210.3 [/h1]
[list]
[*] Card Damage value was converting to range before any bonuses apply. ie. 1 Damage + 3 Affinity Bonus was always 4 (Max) Damage, instead of 2 to 4 Damage as supposed.
[*] In Sandbox Mode: in-between explorations, the previous Graphic Set & Location was displaying when minimizing the World Map to view the Character Sheet. The Headquarters image will be now shown instead.
[*] Attempting to locate a suitable Environment/Faction/Tier-specific encounter could in some cases lead to errors. i.e when such an encounter combination never existed in the Enemy DB in the first place.
[*] When no suitable encounter is present, encounter system will still retry to find another one (but only up to 4 additional times). If despite that no suitable encounter is found, a relevant message will appear and you can freely proceed to the next node.
[*] When no boss retinue can be found, will retry once more with a single +1 level enemy
[/list]

notes.title: Sandbox Mode Preview
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/502081d99341c0dea95594dc020bc70fdee1b92e.jpg[/img]

Hi folks! 

The development of the Sandbox mode is almost finished. And before you get it into your hands next week, let's see what it's really about and what will it miss in the initial implementation.

[h1] Sandbox is a Game Mode [/h1]

Ok, that's obvious. But in reality means a lot in ER: You can customize all its properties and create new custom Sandbox modes.

In fact any Game Mode can be converted into 'Sandbox', by setting the Sandbox property in the game mode json file to true. 

This changes the game loop into sandbox while retaining all your custom Game Mode properties (that aren't stage related). In example you can still adjust how many enemies appear, their stats adjustments, what level you'll start, any special rules like permadeath, fatigue, draw & discard steps etc.

So even though the vanilla Sandbox mode will have permadeath on and will be similar to Ironman in difficulty, you'll be able to create your own custom casual Sandbox modes.

[h1] Sandbox changes (a lot) how the game is played [/h1]

In Gaunlet modes, there are Stages. Defeating the stage boss moves you to a new harder Stage. Eventually all Gaunlet modes end. Even 'Endless' mode is only 1000 Stages long. :P

In Sandbox mode, you instead plan your adventures in the world map. You can choose which locations to visit, and from there choose a quest or an area to explore.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/253fb406eaef41abe68923bb451b1aed1b29376b.jpg[/img]

At that point the world map becomes unavailable till you complete the exploration, and once you do you are back in the world map to plan your next adventure.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/d259a67fe3955279380e10b20d82e126b897bcd9.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/2d66df134bde087a0461ab3d683728a0a864fcef.jpg[/img]

[h1] Areas & Adventures [/h1]

Areas and adventures can be repeatable, meaning you can keep exploring them over and over, till you outgrow their recommended level and move on. Or unique, meaning you can only experience them once.

It's also possible for more areas in a location to become available once the player meet certain requirements.

[h1] Traveling [/h1]

Travelling by land will cost you Rations, while travelling by Sea will cost Farthings. So even if you get stuck in a place due to lack of resources you can in most cases replenish those resources by exploring the areas in your locations. 

In most cases and unless its quest driven, travel will happen automatically but will advance the game time.

[h1] Settlements [/h1]

If your location has a settlement, you can visit it freely and restock your supplies or buy better equipment before embarking on your next adventure. In the same note, the procedurally-generated areas in Sandbox mode will no longer include 'Town' nodes. 

[h1] The Sandbox world is both Endless & Status Quo [/h1]

Meaning that you can play it for as long as you like, but eventually you'll outgrow some locations and be too high-level to have any challenge in them, similarly previously hard areas will get eventually easier. Similarly you can choose at which level you'll face each challenge. Earlier or later is up to you.

[h1] Sandbox Locations are (mostly) moddable [/h1]

Ok. What mostly means, is that even if you can't change the location position in the map or it's name (Lanmerih will always be Lanmerih);  you can change everything in it! 

For example you can add new custom areas in it: like more districts or new dungeons complete with custom stages or whatever you like. Each location can support up to 10 fully moddable areas.

More interestingly, and assuming you aren't in the middle of an exploration, you can switch to a mod altering Locations mid-game. Perhaps to make the Status quo of the world harder and add fresh areas and adventures?

[h1] Ehmm... So Raven what's not done yet exactly? [/h1]

Quite a few things, but the most obvious will be the non-procedural content: Events, Tales, Quests etc. And this huge world may feel empty after a while ;)

So initially the Sandbox build, which you'll get next week will first head in the development branch, where it will get further refined, enriched and tested, before moving it into the main branch by the end of June.

[h1] How the Story mode is different? [/h1]

It's not. The 'Sandbox' mode is where I'll add all the story content: events, quests, short tales and long stories. So in the end they'll become one: The vanilla 'Adventure' mode. 

[b]And that's all the details I can share for now. Stay tuned folks and have a great weekend![/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0206 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
This build adds 2 new Equipment Slots: Armors & Accessories, that will further enhance your tactics and give you an extra edge in higher stages. 

You can read more details on how the new slots work below, and if you still have questions feel free to ask. 

To test them out I also added 80 new cards (that is mostly equipment of the new types.)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/7cd3f2e85e7212791ef9b00ea490e0e55b5d28ab.jpg[/img]

I don't expect the new Armor & Accessory cards to be fully balanced right now, and they may have issues I missed or bugs. (I still didn't have the chance to have a full play-through with them myself.)

That's why they'll be only available in the development branch for a couple of builds even though their functionality is fully implemented, to fine-tune them and to have something new to occupy you, while I am working on the more complex long-term features. In the meantime looking forward for your feedback. ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/1a98ec5498dec266215a3fe1ffb7c6fb66a11fc1.jpg[/img]

[h1] New Equipment Slots - Armors & Accessories [/h1]
[list]
[*] Having an equipped Armor or Accessory is optional
[*] Armors & Accessories go into your inventory and can be freely switched at any moment. 
[*] Their effects trigger at the start of your next turn. (Are automatically used (cast on Player) every turn, at the Start of the Player's turn)
[*] Order of casting is Armor then Accessory. 
[*] This is really important: When using both an Armor & an Accessory, the Armor Synergies will trigger in the Accessory Card (...and any damaging synergies will harm *you*!)
[*] Equipped Armor & Accessory cards have an AP upkeep equal to their AP cost. AP cost is paid (reducted from your AP pool) every turn they activate (whether you can pay it or not!)
[*] Equipped Armor & Accessory cards incur concentration penalty (Count as Actions used towards Fatigue)
[*] Updated 'Equipment' help text to include info on Armors & Accessories
[*] Some Equipment mentions that they Synergize "Health". That's not a typo. They affect the 'Health' of the next Summoning card not your HP.
[*] Some new Summons have Health 0. That's also not a typo & they can only be successfully summoned after 'Health' has been Synergized to them or you are Empowered.
[*] Notes to Modders:
[list]
[*] Armor is declared as Slot:2 & Accessories as Slot:3, both also need to be Persistent:1
[*] Neither should have Echo, as they are cast every turn either way and upon unequip their effect should end!
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes, Additions & Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 80 new Action Cards (mostly Armor & Accessories Equipment)
[*] Attributes help text wasn't mentioning 'Poison' damage source governing attributes
[/list]

[h1] EA Build 0206.1 [/h1]
[list]
[*] When resuming game (passive) Equipment effects (Armor & Accessory) weren't triggering
[*] Whenever you were changing node (passive) Equipment effects would trigger before the debuffing step, debuffing in the process
[*] Changed the trigger order to Echo Actions => Armor => Accessory, to make (passive) Equipment more reliable. Echo synergies will now get attached to your (passive) Equipment and not the other way around. This will significantly reduce the chances of accidental self harm. But you still need to be careful. ;)
[*] Added 19 new Actions Cards
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0205 (Both Branches)
notes.content:
Happy month everyone! 

Today's build includes several quality of life improvements based on your feedback and a couple of bugfixes. You can read everything in the patch notes below. You can also have an exclusive first look in the design of the game world map.

Let's dive in ;)

[h1]Misc Additions & QoL Improvements based on Community Feedback[/h1]

[*] You can now look up Enemies in the Terms Codex.
[*] i.e 'Vampire Bloodmage' will display info of the lowest Vampire Bloodmage in Enemy DB.
[*] i.e 'Vampire Bloodmage - Lv 6' (Case and space sensitive), will display info on the Level 6 variant of the Vampire Bloodmage.
[*] Added the Enemies known Tactics (AI Responses) in their detailed entry. (Both in Enemy Compendium & in the Terms Codex).
[*] Added a button in all encountered Enemies that once clicked will display their Codex entries in the Combat log, similar to typing their full name in the Codex. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/9922e1de9b091581435ed705f45962526c02ddd3.jpg[/img]

[*] Only enemies you have encountered in the past and defeated (in any of your runs) have detailed entries in the terms Codex, whether you access it by searching or via the assorted button. 
[*] Added the Starting Deck composition of each Archetype in their detailed entry. (both in Player's Handbook & in the Term Codex).
[*] Added a button on Unlocked Races & Classes to quickly display their info in the Combat Log.
[*] Added a 'Details' button on Locked Races & Classes to quickly display their info in the Combat Log.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/88db37004103a4e5bfc591d49b68f6c1b2887f53.jpg[/img]

[*] New Shortcut 'L': Collapses/Expands the Combat Log.
[*] Player Class & Level will also display above the XP bar.
[*] Max Health, Max Actions & Hand size will also display in Character Sheet.

[h1] Tales System Additions [/h1]

[*] New Function: "Draft", executing 'Draft' function will open an Action Grimoire from where the player can pick only 1 out of the 4 shown actions.
[*] Example Event/Node: "Draft". Visiting a 'Draft' node or calling the 'Draft' event grants access to 3 Grimoires. Player can then claim only 1 Action from each Grimoire. This nodes isn't used anywhere but you can set your Custom Game Mode to have it as first node through the Game Mode Editor, or use it in your Custom Stages to emulate a Draft sequence.

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Unlocked enemies would only get saved upon quitting the game, but not if the user had restarted the game or the mod manager in-between.
[*] Modded Archetype icons in some cases wouldn't appear in the Player's Handbook Archetype details section.
[*] Archetype icons in some cases would appear as grayscale instead of full color in the Player's Handbook Archetype details section.
[*] Card Copies in hand were losing their 'orange' frame upon resuming a save game (they were still copies in every aspect expect appearance).
[/list]

[h1] Folkswave Map (WIP) [/h1]

For those who still remember Erannorth: The Unfinished Tales, the setting back then was the continent of Elos. 

For those who don't, well you are the majority and it doesn't really matter. 

ER stories will take place in a continent North of Elos, called Folkswave and everything you need to know about Folkswave and its neighbors you'll experience through the Sandbox & Story modes that will be coming later during the EA period.

Since the maps I had made for Unfinished Tales weren't detailing Folkswave much and neither fitted the overall ER mood, in the past days I am also redesigning from scratch the continent map among other things.

This is how it looks so far:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/9fb04eb8dce70cdb53943aeec43a2ba39d2a05b4.png[/img]

Still a work in progress, but I don't think I'll be adding much more detail in it as I feel it'll become too distracting from the actual points of interest, and with my cartography skills I will probably make a mess.

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0204 (Both Branches)
notes.content:
Ever wanted to make your own Stages and enrich them with your own stories and custom events, but not in a random procedural fashion? 

Maybe slow things down, add more choices and make things less linear. Perhaps by having a custom event every other node that allows you to choose the node after it. Hey! Do you want to fight the elite or get for free three actions?

Or make things more combat oriented. Drop all events and have elite fight after elite fight.

Or maybe have the first 10 nodes filled with dead adventurers or a custom event that lets you pick cards to create something like a draft mode and pick actions and gear for the entirety of your next run?

Well now you can do all these.

This build includes all the tools you need to create even more unique Game Modes ;)

[h1] Moddable Custom Stages [/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now define Custom Stage Sets as Mods
[*] Each Stage Set is declared as a .json file and needs to be placed in ../Content/Stages or in ../Mods/[Your Mod]/Stages
[*] Each Stage Set can contain up to 20 User Defined Stages, If the Game Mode contains more than 20 Stages, 21+ Stages will get procedurally generated
[*] All .json files in the above folders will be loaded to the StagesDB, but will be used only if the Game Mode makes use of this Custom Set
[*] You should always include ONLY one 'DungeonEntry' & 'Boss' nodes at Start & End of Stage
[*] Killing a Boss is necessary in order to advance to the next Stage
[*] Other nodes you can include are: Encounter, Elite, Camp, Intersection, CaveIntersection, BanditCampIntersection, DungeonIntersection, Town, Treasure, Event, Merchant or a Tale ID
[*] Stage Nodes can have as value a Tale ID, the icon will appear as a questionmark but the chosen tale will trigger once visiting this node.
[*] Since at this point the Environmental Graphics can't be changed it's advisable to use 'Intersection', and let the StageManager decide if this is a Cave, Bandit Camp or Dungeon
[*] Inside the stages folder you'll find a CStageTemplate.json file to use as a template, you are free to add as many nodes you like in each of the 20 custom stages, and use as many of them as you like in your Game Mode. i.e You may only want to edit & use the 3 first. In this case you can leave the Stages 4 to 20 as they are, since they won't be used. But if your mod user decides to add extra stages in their run, nothing will break.
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode Setting [/h1]
[list]
[*] UseCustomStageSet:[Set name], if defined will use the Custom Stage Set named [Set name] instead of the vanilla procedurally generated Stages.
[*]  When using a 'CustomStageSet' in a game mode you should never set a 'StartingStageLength' and won't make much sense to set a 'StartingNode'.
[*] On a different note, the StartingNode can now also be a Tale ID
[/list]

[h1] Additions and Enhancements in the Tales system [/h1]
[list]
[*] Tales can be chained by using the Tale ID as the function to execute (this will work if there isn't already a function of the same name)
[*] Current functions are: Camp, Rations, Chest, Backpack, Pouch, Grimoire, Journal, Merchant, Town, Cave, Bandit Camp, Dungeon, Path & Onwards
[*] i.e "Choice_1_ExecuteFunction":"Adventurer Corpse I", will load the 'Adventurer Corpse I' story when you click Choice 1
[*] When chaining Tales its not necessary for the choice to has its own text, as the chained tale loads instantly, so the choice uses the next tale narrative as its outcome
[*] This way you can write individual scenes and chain them together to create a 'choose your own adventure' story right now. But there will probably be a more efficient way for that in the future.
[*] It's recommended when creating large stories by chaining tales, to create each of these large stories as a separate mod.
[*] Level:x & Stage:x can be used as checks in the Tale & Choice 'requirement' fields
[*] Level:x, check is passed if the player level is higher/equal than x
[*] Stage:x, check is passed if the current stage is higher/equal than x
[*] NextNode:[Node] can be used as a choice reward to change the next Stage node into [Node] which can also be a Tale ID. ie. NextNode:Merchant, will summon a merchant in the next node, and NextNode:Adventurer Corpse I, a dead adventurer to loot.
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Flight status would break at HP/3 instead of HP/2
[*] Card XP gain function was called twice on 'Self' cards
[*] Enemy Modification rules was displaying their values as +x% which was inaccurate, it now instead displays as x%
[/list]

[h1] EA Build 0204.1 [/h1]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] When an Action fizzles has damage output but deals 0 damage for any reason (low proficiency, flying enemy etc.)	the message will now simply display that Action dealt 0 damage.
[*] Damage roll will only appear if either Damage or Intense Damage, or Split Damage exist and it's not converted to 0 due to low proficiency or flying enemy etc.
[*] Damage output will only Split (if there is a reason to) only if it haven't been set to zero for any reason (low proficiency, flying enemy etc.)
[/list]

[h1] Tales System Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Encounter:[Random] & [RandomElite] can be used as choice reward to trigger a random Normal or Elite Encounter
[*] Encounter:[Enemy - Lv x], can be used as choice reward to trigger encounter with a specified enemy (Enemy needs to exist in DB). i.e Order Recruit - T2, can be found from Level 2 to 12 (Non-Boss Enemies have a DB entry from Level [Tier] till Level [Tier + 10]).		[*] For example you can use "Choice_1_Reward":"Encounter:Order Recruit - Lv 2, Encounter:Order Recruit - Lv 3" to summon 2 Order Recruits to fight the player, if they take this choice. But "Encounter:Order Recruit - Lv 1" wouldn't have any effect as this enemy doesn't exist.
[*] You can see the Enemy Tiers in the compendium and calculate their level range
[*] When triggering encounters from Events, the event box will hide, and choice outcome will display in the combat log.
[/list]

[h1] EA Build 0204.2 [/h1]
[list]
[*] Flamemare and a couple more enemies were factionless, creating (consistent) encounters with just them. It's still possible to get a full encounter of them, but it should be rarer.
[*] Slightly reduced Flamemare's Power & Health, Increased Tier to 5 from 4
[/list]

[h1] EA Build 0204.3[/h1]

[h1] Balance Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced Empower bonus in Concealment
[*] Slightly Reduced values/Nerfed Actions with the Kill effect
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Air Conduit was incorrectly granting +3% concealment instead of the mentioned +5%
[/list]

[h1] Tales System Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] All reward keywords can be turned into chance for a 'reward' by prepending 'Chance>x>' before the [Reward]
[*] i.e "Choice_1_Reward":"Craft:Firebolt, Chance>25>Encounter:Random"
[*] Will give player a 'Firebolt' in hand, but also has a 25% chance to trigger a random encounter 
[*] i.e "Choice_1_Reward":"Craft:Firebolt, Chance>50>Craft:Firebolt, Chance>25>Cast:Firebolt"
[*] Will give player a 'Firebolt', adds a 50% chance to get an additional 'Firebolt', and a 25% chance to have a Firebolt blow on Player's face (with stats as if casted by the Player)
[/list]

[h1] Card Text Modifications [/h1]
[list]
[*] 'Equipment (Type) Requires Level x', when you don't meet the equipment requirements will now appear as: Equipment (Type - Lvl x)
[*] 'Sneak Attack' effect will now read: "Sneak Attack xY." and expanded: 'While Concealed, Action Deals xY Damage. You lose all Concealment'
[*] 'Festering Wound x' shortened to just 'Festering x'
[*] 'Silver' effect will now read: "Silver xY." and expanded: 'Deal xY Damage if the Target is Vampire, Lycanthrope or Monster.'
[*] 'Blessed' effect will now read: "Blessed +x." and expanded: 'Deal +x Damage if the Target is Undead, Spirit or Demon.'
[*] 'Fatigue x' will simply read: 'Fatigue +x'
[/list]


[h1] EA Build 0204.4 [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a formatting/display issue in the Sneak Attack effect description
[*] Fixed a formatting/display issue in the Merchant Event
[*] In Game Mode Editor 'Starting Stage' was incorrectly saying 'Start from Stage x (+x in Stage Length)' it was corrected to 'Start from Stage x (+x Stages to Complete Run). This means simply is that if you create a run that ends after 3 stages, but starts at Stage 3, your run will start at Stage 3 and end at Stage 6.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0203 (Both Branches)
notes.content:
If you've been following the development branch, this build concludes the initial implementation of the Tales system and also implements an improved Summon Save state. It doesn't add yet any new events to the game.

For everyone in the main branch, this build brings it up to speed with all the latest development builds 0200 => 0203. Main features being the Game Mode Editor, the new Events system & all the changes below. So make sure to check all the relevant patch notes, if you haven't already, to get up to speed. ;)

[h1] Enhanced Summon Save State [/h1]
[list]
[*] All Summoned Allies are saved regardless if they are unique or not
[*] Non-unique Summon names may receive a different number upon load i.e your Zombie:3, might become Zombie:1 if former Zombie:1 & 2 are dead. All other stats will be as saved.
[/list]

[h1] Initial Implementation of the Tales System & Misc Changes [/h1]

The initial implementation of the Tales system is complete and you can start creating your own events that can harm or benefit the player. 

Note though, that all events can be (currently) skipped by hitting the [Spacebar] or Ending your turn. That won't be eventually the case, and you'll be able to mercilessly throw the PC into a bottomless pit trap. But for now the events essence isn't to cause an inescapable hazard but instead to give the player [b]a choice[/b] to get something, at the cost of something else. At least that's the direction the vanilla events will be heading. You are free to use and abuse the new system to your heart's content. I'll be updating later today the Modding Guide with information how to create your new events, and play them right away. Which is really easy and straightforward to do ;)

[list]
[*] Tale window shifted up & Loot window shifted down, to both be able to read the choice outcome & claim your reward. 
[*] Only Tales with 'AutoIncludeInEventNode:true' are automatically added to the event node and have 1 out 5 chance to appear when visiting the event node.
[*] Looting Event has 4 out 5 chance to appear when visiting the event node, and will also be used as a fallback when there aren't any Unique events in the database.
[*] Auto-included Tales can be either unique or non-unique (As defined by their 'Unique' value). Non-Unique tales may reappear, while unique tales will appear only once.
[*] Unique tales have a priority to appear, if the one picked randomly is already played, or its requirements aren't met then a non-unique tale will be used instead.
[/list]

[b] Giving rewards to the player [/b]

[u]Each choice reward field can accept:[/u]

a) the name of a perk as value. 
[list]
[*] Perks can be awarded only once, so make sure they are unique and not part of a class or race perk list.
[*] Perk description is appended in the story outcome text.
[*] The Perk XP unlock cost is ignored and has no effect, but it still need to be set when declaring the perk.
[/list]

b) Craft:Cardname, to craft and give player a copy of Cardname
[list]
[*] i.e Craft:Reanimate, will give player a copy of Reanimate in hand
[*] Card can be an equipment card, but that won't equip that equipment or add it to the player's inventory
[/list]

c) Cast:Cardname, to use Cardname on the Player
[list]
[*] i.e Cast:Omega, will summon the Omega unique companion
[/list]
	
d) A comma separated list of all the above
[list]
[*] i.e Morheliss Blessing, Cast:Omega, Craft:Fireball, Craft:Fireball
[*] Choice will grant: the Morheliss Blessing perk, Cast Action 'Omega' and craft 2 Fireball Copies, (not that the particular combo makes any sense, but you get the point)
[/list]

[b] Restricting choices based on player's stats & attributes [/b]

[u] Each choice requirement field can accept: [/u]

a) Race:[Race], will check if the Player is of chosen race
b) Class:[Class], will check if the Player is of chosen class
c) Gender:[Gender], will check if the Player is of chose gender
d) [Attribute]:x, will check if the Player's [Attribute] is higher/equal to x. ie. Strength:15
e) A comma separated list of all the above
[list]
[*]  i.e Race:Vampire, Strength:20, Agility:20
[*[ Choice will become non interactable if the player fails in any of the checks.
[*]Unique Tales can also have a 'Requirements' field, and the player needs to pass their requirements before the tale appears
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0202 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
This build moves all the current events and loot opportunities to a new (moddable) event/story system. The new system is still a work in progress and will take couple more days to fully mature. 

But all the existing events have already migrated and utilize it. So let me know If you encounter any issues. 

Once this new system is complete you'll be able to add your own events & stories in the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/6ad541f89fbc439373923dfb3a5b420f89eee940.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/a2ab6565ecfc3d8ecd6e70e3240bff410ccaffe8.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/722c629a2b1b23427c3e45cf1bf13040012487a8.jpg[/img]

[h1] New Moddable Event/Story System - Tales [/h1]
[list]
[*] Tales are mini events (or short stories) that will also prompt you for 1 to 4 choices
[*] Each choice can lead to an outcome, different rewards or penalties or call a specific function (among a list of predefined functions) ie to Open a Grimoire, Interact with a Merchant, Generate an area to explore or trigger an encounter etc.
[*] Tales are defined as self-contained json files, you can edit as plain text files.
[*] ModManager will load automatically any Tale json file located in ../Mods/[Your Mod]/Tales or in ../Content/Tales and adds them to TalesDB. All events listed in TalesDB can then potentially appear in the event node if their requirements are met.
[*] A TaleTemplate.json file is provide for modders (and of course all the existing events) to use as template for your own events
[*] Custom Artworks for Tales specified in the tales json files, should be located in ../Mods/[Your Mod]/CustomArtworks/Tales folder
[*] All the old events and loot opportunities are already migrated to the new Tales system.
[*] I will be expanding the modding guide with more info on how to use the Event/Story system once its fully implemented. [i]Missing functionality: [ 1) Implement Unique field, Requirement fields & Reward fields & 2)  Event node chooses and triggers a random event from the DB ][/i]
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes & Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Endless, Expert & Custom Modes (that don't overload vanilla Casual, Normal or Ironman) will display the full run modifications/ruleset. Casual, Normal & Ironman rules will appear like before.
[*] If you forgot or are unsure of what rules are you playing in, you can look them up in the terms codex. Using the Game Mode name. This will also work for any custom rulesets.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/16de11e15728c8db17d6f79d555c3f98590c9e12.jpg[/img]

[*] You can now loot both the backpack & the grimoire/journal when the opportunity is presented. (Loot will become a bit scarcer once more events are added to the ? node.)
[*] Backpacks & Grimoire journals now contain 2-4 items at random, instead of 3
[*] Wandering Merchants will show you 4 items instead of 3
[*] You can now rest even when your rations have run out, but instead of 10 AP & HP, you'll only restore 2 AP & 2 HP.
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Character sheet button was partially covered by an invisible object making clicks at the left-center of the button not registering.
[*] Action Effects that were not receiving an Evolution or Empower bonus weren't displaying any Perk bonus/penalties in the card description. Effects affected with this visual glitch were: Multicast, Sneak Attack, Silver, Desecrate, Consecrate, Empower. In the cases of Spellcraft & Synergy[Effect] the corresponding perk bonus was also not applying.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0201 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
We all know that ER is moddable, and that you can customize everything by editing plain text files, but still for some this might still feel scary. 

[i]What if I break something?[/i]

[i]Nah, let's just wait till someone else mod this & that for me. [/i]

Well you can't really break anything. Bad mods can just be deleted, Steam can restore your game files and everything will be just fine. But still. 

What if you could create as many new Game modes you'd like just by selecting values in dropdown menus? And have them exported automatically as a Mod you can then activate/deactivate, expand with more game modes and delete when you are bored of it?

Well now you can, and the difficulty/balance of your game is in your fingertips, even if you are hesitant or just bored to mod things. ;)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/927a4d4d5d46243b9ce8927299ac05aeecf06da4.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/e565d1c72528fa62e4847a3d4d402b43faa874b1.jpg[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/8a4c7ca13c2040ddaa1dc500d1c0194233fa8c6e.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/b69351cd8ad1bbc12eab8dac250bbee0c6008f26.jpg[/img]

[h1] Custom Game Mode Editor [/h1]
[list]
[*] A visual tool that creates new Game Modes as Mods.
[*] The game modes are playable right away. But optionally you can then edit their .json files in a text editor to fine-tune them further. As I can't provide every possible imaginable value in a dropdown, and input fields would beat the purpose of having a visual tool.
[*] You can create any number of Game Modes you wish (within reason)
[*] You can specify the Game Mode name & it will be saved along with all your Game Modes in the Mod folder: 'User GameModes'
[*] You can overwrite your custom Game Modes by specifying the same Game Mode name
[*] You can overload Vanilla Game Modes by specifying their Game Mode name ie. Casual
[*] You can delete and deactivate the User GameModes mod from the Mod Manager
[*]  Game Mode Properties that can be adjusted:
[list]
[*] How many Enemies will appear in Normal Encounters
[*] How many Enemies will appear in Elite Encounters
[*] Modify Enemies Health Multiplier
[*] Modify Enemies Power Multiplier
[*] Adjust which Enemies have Resistances
[*] Modify Enemies Resistances Multiplier
[*] Max Elite level in comparison to current stage
[*] Start adventure at higher level
[*] Change your XP multiplier
[*] Adjust your starting HP
[*] Adjust your starting Wealth
[*] Adjust Stage Length & Initial Stage
[*] Adjust Stage bonus rewards upon completion
[*] Specify the first node you'll visit
[*] Adjust or Disable the Fatigue System
[*] Enable Permadeath or Specify save retain penalties
[*] Use custom Draw Phase rules
[*] Enable & customize a Discard phase
[/list]
[/list]

[i] Wait! This mean I can cheat! Create for example a 3 Stage Run with super-easy opponents and get loads of tokens & mastery?[/i]

Well yes. Or you could just edit your save files, way faster and easier. 

It's your game. Mod it, break it, make it more challenging, super easy, impossible. Whatever is fun for you. I am here to provide the tools not to judge you ;)

[h1] New Moddable Game Mode Properties [/h1]
[list]
[*] EnemyHealthMultiplier x: Multiply enemy health by x (float: i.e 0.5 sets to half, 1.2 sets to 20% higher etc.)
[*] EnemyPowerMultiplier x: Multiply enemy power by x (float). ( Enemy Max Damage = Power & Min Damage = Power/2 )
[*] EnemiesWithResistance x: x is Vanilla, Boss or None. Vanilla will leave the resistance system as is. Boss will remove resistances from non boss enemies. None will remove resistances from everyone. (Both positive & negative)
[*] PositiveEnemyResistanceMultiplier x: Multiply positive enemy resistances by x (float)
[*] NegativeEnemyResistanceMultiplier x: Multiply negative enemy resistances by x (float)
[*] Enemy modifications are per game mode basis & they will appear modified in Enemy Compendium once the game mode that modifies them is started.
[*] The final results of these calculations a rounded down to integer values. But Enemy Health & Power can never drop below 1.
[*] Modmanager will reset when restarting or soft-restarting the game and Enemies will set back to their original stats
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Enemy AI Response Cards will now Stay visible for [Enemy Attack Speed] + 0.3s. Default is 1.2s Attack Speed & 1.5s for the AI Response Cards (Before it was 1.5s regardless your Attack Speed Setting)
[*] Game Mode Property "StartingNode" wasn't working for other nodes other Town.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0199 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
Most of the recent Patches have been all about buffing the Player, customizable Attributes, better Level up, New Races, Classes, Actions &  Action Effects, Perks etc. All the while, the poor monsters were feeling really neglected and rightly so. Well it's time for their vengeance!

Difficulty should now be much closer to the recommended Mastery levels, but of course you are free to mod and fine-tune things to your liking and skill level. 

I have updated the Modding guide to include the new keywords available for defining and customizing Game Modes, and the archetype's section with the new AI keywords you can use in your custom enemies.

I'll explain them briefly below:

[h1] New Enemy AI Behaviors [/h1]

[list]
[*][b] Flyby Attack [/b]

[list]
[*] Flying Enemy will lose a Flying Counter to Attack twice this turn.
[*] When enemies use the Flyby Attack they will receive Retribution damage, but only once.
[*] Enemies won't use Flyby Attack if they have 1 or less Flying Counters
[*]  (This AI response doesn't create a status effect icon, just a floating indication card & combat log message)
[*] Wyverns & Demons have Flyby Attack
[/list]

[*][b]  Spiked Armor [/b] 

[list]
[*] Unless targeted with a Ranged Action, this enemy will deal Retribution Damage once attacked. This Damage is Intense & proportional to the Action's Damage or Action's Level.
[*] Stunned, Frozen & Entangled enemies still deal this retribution damage to the player, as Spiked Armor is a passive effect
[*] If the Action has a Direct single Target Damage effect ie. Wrath, Damage, Poison, Intense etc, 25% of that Damage is dealt back to the caster as Intense Retribution Damage. Bonus modifiers like Double, Sneak Attack etc won't apply. 
[*] Multicast will also trigger Spiked Armor as it individually targets each target.
[*] If the Action doesn't deal Damage, the Retribution Damage returned is equal to Action Level + 3.
[*] Ulniir, Devils, Wyverns & Zreeblik Race and Death Knight Class Enemies have Spiked Armor.
[/list]

[*][b]  Counter Attack [/b] 

[list]
[*] Unless targeted with a Ranged Action, this enemy will always Counter Attack (using their default attack card) each and every time they are attacked.
[*] Multicast will also trigger counter attack as it individually targets each target.
[*] This attack obviously won't receive player's retribution but can be resisted & defended.
[*]  Immobilized (Stunned), Bewitched, Entangled & Frozen enemies won't Counter Attack, as Counter Attack is an active effect.
[*]  Blademaster Class Enemies have Counter Attack.
[/list]

[*][b]  Warcry [/b] 

[list]
[*] All Enemies in the Battlefield gain x Rage Counters, where x is equal to half the Warcry caster's level or up to a Max value of +3 for level 6+.
[*] Once the enemy allies act their Rage counters will either drop by 1 if they use a different AI response than Enrage, or increase by +1 as Enrage is now a valid response even on AIs that normally don't Enrage.
[*] Each enemy can use Warcry only once.
[*] Ulniir Race & Battlerager Class Enemies have Warcry.
[/list]

[*][b]  Illusory Copy [/b] 

[list]
[*] Enemy will attempt to create a copy of themselves that is 1 level lower than them.
[*] If such a level exists a clone of them will be created.
[*] Each Copy will further attempt to copy themselves.
[*] Devileye, Yakt & Sylph Race and Illusionist Class Enemies have Illusory Copy.
[/list]

[*][b] Dispel [/b] 

[list]
[*] Enemy will attempt a level-based roll to debuff all active buffs in Player (defend, retribution, empower etc.)
[*] They can attempt Dispel again only once all their Dispel counters are gone.
[*] Mystic is the only Enemy class with this ability.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Misc Changes & Additions [/h1]

[list]
[*] Ranged keyword now reads: 'Ranged Actions can harm Flying Targets, won't provoke Counter Attack or receive damage from Spiked Armor.'
[*] Flying enemies will lose all they flying counters if they attempt to act with 50% or HP, or if they get Stunned, Entangled or Frozen.
[*] Stun, Entangle & Freeze effects can only affect flying targets if they are part of a Ranged Action.
[*] Rage will now stop increasing once it reaches 5 counters, and when it does, all rage counters will get removed. Depending how enemy got it in the first place, a new sequence of rage may start over or not.
[*] Negative Statuses applied on Enemies & AI Responses can now be searched in the Terms Codex.
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]

[list]
[*] Drain effect will no longer trigger if the Action isn't ranged & the enemy is flying
[*] Neutralized Effects in cards due to positive or negative perk bonuses will no longer appear.   Neutralized effects aren't subject to Evolution or Empower and will never trigger or reappear in the card unless the Effect (defined) value + the Perk Bonus/Penalty becomes greater or less than 0, or are re-synergized into the card.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0198 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
[h1] New Enemies, Flying Behavior & Ranged Actions/Equipment [/h1]
[list]
[*] New Action Effect: Ranged.
[*] Ranged property allow Actions to damage directly enemies with flying.
[*] Added the Ranged keyword to all relevant Actions.
[*] New AI Response: Flying
[*] While an enemy is Flying, they can only be harmed (directly) by Actions with the 'Ranged' property, and their attacks won't trigger retribution counterattack.
[*] Flying enemies can still receive Bewitch damage from Allies, Chain damage, AoE damage etc. Additionally, when any Stun, Entangle or Frozen effect resolves in the target, their Flying Status will be temporarily removed.
[*] Enemies who lose over 50% of their HP can no longer fly.
[*] Demon, Devileye, Insect & Wraith Enemies have flying.
[*] Separated all enemies into factions, to create more varied & challenging encounters.
[*] Added 30 new Enemies.
[/list]

[h1] New Moddable Game Mode Properties [/h1]
[list]
[*] DiscardPhase:[true/false], Enforces a (random) discard phase at End of Turn (Default, if omitted is false)
[*] DiscardDownTo:x, if DiscardPhase is true, Player will discard at random down to x cards at End of Turn (Default, if omitted is down to 0 => Entire Hand)
[*] DrawPhase:x, At the start of the new turn, Player will draw +x Cards in addition to their equipment. Unless used with a Discard phase player will keep stockpiling more cards each turn. 
(Default, if omitted or is set to 0 is to draw up to the vanilla intellect based [Hand] size value.)
[/list]

[h1] Misc Additions & Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Before saving the game progress, a fresh hand and player's equipment is first drawn
[*] 'Fatigue' & 'Discard' Action effects won't increase through out the Action's Evolution & will remain fixed to their set value
[*] Focus & Invoke will allow you to draw or create cards, as long as (at the time of their casting) you have 6 or less cards in your hand.
[*] Focus x will now read: Draw x Cards. Effect is ignored if you already have 7+ Action Cards.
[*] Invoke x will now read: Create & Draw x Random Actions. Effect is ignored if you already have 7+ Action Cards.
[*] AI Defensive Stance, Concealment & Incorporeal response hover help wasn't mentioning that they don't trigger retribution counterattacks.
[*] When choosing a Race & Class, your mastery with it, will appear inside parenthesis in the overview box. i.e Lycanthrope (+117) etc.
[/list]


[h1] EA Build 0198.1 [/h1]
[list]
[*] Flying enemies will get 3 counters once the effect triggers, then each turn loose a counter. This way you still have an opening to kill them without any ranged cards, or reduce their health once they lose their last counter and before they get their 3 next counters.
[*] Drain Soul, didn't have a combat log message
[*] Giant Beetle had the wrong artwork
[*] Empower wasn't reducing by -1 after ending your turn with enemies present. (when no enemies were present it was properly completely debuffing)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0197 (Both Branches)
notes.content:
[h1] New Level up System [/h1]

Level up will no longer increase your dominant attributes but instead give you 1 LP (Level up Point). You can increase any attribute you wish by spending your LP. Attributes less than 16 need 1 LP to increase. Attributes equal or higher than 16 need 2 LP to increase. The arrows to increase attributes will become inactive once you have no LP or insufficient LP to upgrade an attribute. HP & AP will increase like before.

[h1] New Moddable Game Mode properties [/h1]

[list]
[*] PlayerLevelAdjustment:x, Player will start the game at level x and with +25*x XP to spend in perks [Default if not set is 1 (Level 1)]
[*] PlayerWealthAdjustment:x, Player will start the game with x Farthings [Default if not set is 25 + 50xPlayerLevelAdjustment]
[*] StartingStage:x, Player will start their adventure in Stage x [Default if not set is 1 (Stage 1)]
[*] StartingStageLength:x, if you set the StartingStage x more than 1+, this property will override the initial length of that Stage to x.
[*] StartingNode:[Node], Set the 1st Node the player visits to the chosen node. [Default if not set is "Encounter"]
[*]1st Node is the one after the Entry as the 'Entry' always need to exist
[*] Possible Nodes are: Encounter, Event, Elite, DungeonIntersection, CaveIntersection, BanditCampIntersection,Town, Camp, Merchant & Boss.
[/list]

[h1] New Game Mode: Expert [/h1]

Added a new Mode "Expert" as an example for modders on how to use these new settings in practice. Expert Mode starts the Player at Level 5 & at Stage 3. The first node you visit is a Town to invest your initial 225 Farthings.

[h1] Other notable additions & balance changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Hand Size can never exceed 7 (even with Perk Bonuses). Named Copies are still created even if you exceed a Hand size of 7, but not Invoked ones.
[*] Archetype Cache is now also purged when Restarting the Modmanager to allow overloading of archetypes without restarting the game itself.
[*] Intellect Bonus to starting hand reduced by -1. (Intellect 20 will now give Hand 6. Instead of Hand 7.)
[*] Improved Focus & Invoke algorithms
[*] Slightly improved Blood Mage's Actions to increase their survivability in earlier levels
[*] If Sneak Attack effect is synergized in a Card with only the AoE Damage effect, AoE will now benefit from the Sneak Attack bonus
[*] If Sneak Attack effect is synergized in a Card with both a Single Target Damage Effect & AoE Damage Effect, only the single Target Damage will benefit from the Sneak Attack bonus
[*] Vulnerability will pass to Intense Damage Effect & then to AoE Damage Effect if the Card doesn't have a Single Target Damage Effect, otherwise it will apply in the Single Target Damage Effect.
[*] Amplify bonus is now applied after the card damage is split to min & max damage range, and in most cases will result in a slightly higher damage output.
[*] Both the Split Element & the main Card Element are now Amplified. In example If Damage is Split, due to the Split or Imbue effects, the appropriate Amplify bonus will apply separately to each half of the damage. (Instead of the total.) So instead of rolling +3 Dark & +3 Bludgeoning damage you might for example end up rolling +4 Dark & +6 Bludgeoning Damage etc. In this case the combat log message will say that the enemy suffered 10 Dark+Bludgeoning Damage.
[*] If an AoE Damage effect exists along with a Single Target Damage Effect it will get separately Amplified & the Amplify Bonus will get reduced an additional time.
[*] Resistance will now trigger before Defend. Resistance will first try to absorb a portion of (or all) the damage, then Defend will try to absorb a portion of (or all) the damage, then any remaining damage is dealt normally.
[*] Card Copies created in your hand from Spellcraft or Invoke effects will appear in a dark red card frame to distinguish them from the cards in your deck
[/list]


[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]

[list]
[*] Perks that modify Effects, was incorrectly modyfing every effect's text instead of only that of the boosted effect. (This was a visual glitch & effects were otherwise calculated correctly.)
[*] Draw Hand was incorrectly using 7 as limit instead of Hand Size.
[*] Summoning & Discarding Equipment Cards was a cause of miscalculating the cards in Hand due to the asynchronous nature of creation & destruction.
[*] In certain mouse misbehaving cases an invisible object would spawn in the enemy area, it wasn't visible to the player but was preventing click methods to trigger in certain cases. 
[*] In certain mouse misbehaving cases or low frame rate cases action cards could stick in the battlefield. Momentarily dragging any other card or enemy will now make the formerly stuck card draggable once more.
[*] Any 'invisible' or stuck objects caused by mouse misbehaving or low frame rate will now get destroyed at end of turn,  once moving to a new node or any action card is played, to prevent unforseen errors and game stability issues.
[*] In certain cases enemy attack loop would skip the right-most enemy if their left-most companion met an untimely doom (i.e from retribution, bewitch, desecration etc.) The issue seems to be fixed for now, so let me know if it happens again.
[/list]

Last but not least I uploaded an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/erannorthreborn/mods/6]unofficial mod[/url] in Nexus for everyone who wants to lift the lore-based Gender Restrictions in Warlock, Spelldancer, Nymph & Ifrit classes & races, or to just see an example of a mod overloading core Classes & Races in action.

[h1] EA Build 0197.1 [/h1]
[list]
[*] Replicate copies will also appear in a dark red card frame to distinguish them from the cards in your deck
[*] Rearranging Enemies wasn't changing their attack order or their multicast order (after the 0197 update)
[*] Multicast [Self] wasn't triggering properly
[*] Synergy Meditate wasn't triggering properly
[*] Color coded the merchandise buttons in town (Actions & Consumables are Dark purple & Equipment dark brown)
[*] Actions you have 3 Copies will now appear without a Buy button in Towns
[*] Equipment you have 1 Copy & its equipped will now appear without a Buy button in Towns
[*] You can now sell owned and unequipped Equipment in Towns for half its price. Sell button will appear in medium red color to easily distinguish it.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0196 (Both Branches)
notes.content:
[h1]EA Build 0196 (Both Branches)[/h1]

Synergy can seem really complex, in your first few interactions with those cards. As there is no way for me to know which cards you'll synergize and do the math for you. But to get a better understanding how the synergy actually affects your cards, a compact card text will now show in the log under [cardname=>target] (and it will include all the modifications the card received).

[i]In the screenshot below notice the difference between the "Look into my Eyes" in my hand and the one played after "And Now Sleep" in the log.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/973f36227c940fa8c5636f8e33d9fb3ec54b2b76.jpg[/img]


Wandering why your second Echo damaged you? Well you can now see in the log that it was because your first Echo, synergized it with Damage & you where its target. 

I have faith, that with a little practice you'll soon learn how to use too this powerful mechanic. And to predict exactly what will be the outcome of your combos. Of course if you have questions I am always here to help. ;)

Another concern about Synergy is that it's quite hard to memorize & learn all the keywords that can be synergized at once, and rightly so because there are over 80 keywords currently; and synergy was crafted in a way to support all present and future keywords. So whenever you wonder what a keyword does, you can look it up in the Terms Codex.

[i]In the screenshot below I did 3 searches: "Phantasmal Blade", "Weaken" & "Synergy". The log will stay intact till you clear it or you move to a new node.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/f4a367e2870f761c114771d09f705957021cb4c3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Terms Codex[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an input field in the top part of the Combat log. There you can research various terms.
[*] Type your research term & hit enter or click the research button. All matches in the codex will show up.
[*] You can use the input field in the combat log to search for Card Effects, Races, Classes, Cards & Perks.
[*] For example you can search for Vampire while creating your character to get a look at the Vampire stats, proficiency & resistances. Or for 'Focus' if you are wondering what this keyword does once synergized into a Card. etc.
[*] You can also view the help sections that appear in Character Sheets & the Shortcuts button there by searching for Attributes,Deck,Equipment,Perks & Shortcuts.
[/list]

[h1] Bug fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 1 missing background image in Ice Caves & 2 in Infernal Caves that could cause in certain cases the game background to turn white
[*] Gluttony was incorrectly tagged as a hostile effect marking cards with it as 'Enemy'
[*] EnemyBane wasn't tagged at all. It's now classified as a hostile effect, marking cards with it as 'Enemy'.
[*] Improved the Drawing algorithm to take into account cards that perceived as present but are in reality marked for destruction
[*] Hex AI Response and Discard Effect will take into account cards that perceived as present but are in reality marked for destruction and won't count them when discarding cards from the player's hand.
[*] When loading a saved game: Hand Draw & Summon Equipment logic was triggering when it shouldn't (as the exact hand you had was already saved & loaded, creating in some cases double copies of cards)
[*] Card values will now refresh each time a Perk is unlocked to display any changes caused by said perk.
[*] Gender restrictions in Classes weren't enforced correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Build 0195 (Both Branches)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/6d3b27f6d60457c4645384ff744ab018ef633ff6.jpg[/img]

I think the timing wouldn't have been better & right on time to celebrate 1 month in Early Access. ;)

[b]The free class & race expansion pack introducing 5 additional races & 7 additional classes (each with its own skill cards & several unique perks) is now fully playable and integrated to the main game along with the related mastery achievements.[/b]

I had initially planned to include 8 new classes, but I didn't like how the Greenshaper was coming forth, so the class got cut for now. 

At the moment of this writing we are at 9 Races, 15 Classes, 891 Action Cards, over 80 Action keywords. All of them in my opinion can offer you distinctive runs of varied difficulty and complexity. Therefore I won't be adding any additional Classes or Races for the remainder of the EA (except perhaps the Greenshaper), but I'll happily support and guide any modders who undertake further expanding the game classes and races. 

Instead I'll be expanding further the existing classes & races and balance them further based on your feedback. But my main focus will shift to the new game modes which I expect they'll happily devour most of the development time for the rest 2-5 months of the EA.

Build 0195 is now live in both the Stable & Development Branches. 

[b]Further development & content updates & bugfixes will once more be heading to the Development Branch till the Sandbox mode is completed as well.[/b]

[i]If you weren't following the Development Branch, you can review older Patch Notes in the Discussion Forum.[/i]

[h1] EA Build 0195 (Both Branches) [/h1]

[h1] Misc Additions & Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*]Added 60 new Actions
[*]Whenever a Synergy is active a reminder text will appear above your hand cards mentioning the active synergies.

[*]Inquisitor & Runecaster classes are fully playable (have access to 18 Skills & 14+ Perks)

[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0193 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
[h1] EA Build 0193 - Development Branch [/h1]

Build 0193 brings 14 new Action Effects modders can use while creating new Actions. All 5 new Races are fully playable increasing your Race choices to 9, and Blood Mage is also playable with access to an initial set of 18 Skills & 14 Perks.

Keep in mind that by playable I don't mean balanced at this point. And by balanced I never mean equality. Overall the Race & Class expansion will be costing more Tokens to unlock & as such they should provide (once finalized) a much more complex game play experience and an increased power level in comparison to the initial classes & races.

If you find things too hard or too easy, adjust your difficulty settings and give me some feedback ;)

[h1] Misc Changes & Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*]Detailed Card descriptions are now shorter and more to the point.
[*]All New races are fully playable & have access to 12 Skills, 12+ Perks & additional hand-picked non-skill Cards from other disciplines or their own
[*]Blood Mage class is playable (has access to 12 Skills & 12+ Perks)
[*]Added 22 New Traits
[*]Added 29 New Actions
[/list]

[h1] New Action Effects [/h1]
[list]
[*]Discard:x => Discard up to x Cards at Random.
[*]Explode:x => If target dies from this Action, each other enemy suffers x intense damage.
[*]Greed:x => Target suffers +x damage + 1 for each card in your hand.
[*]Gluttony:x => You (or ally) restore +x HP + 1 for each card in your hand
[*]Wrath:x => Target suffers +x + Your retribution damage. Debuff Retribution.
[*]Sloth:x => Target suffers +x damage + 2 for each card in your hand. Discard your Hand.
[*]Envy:x => Target suffers +x damage +1 for every Hit Point you are missing.
[*]Lust:x => Bewitched Enemies suffer x Intense Damage + 5 for each Bewitched enemy damaged before them.
[*]Pride:x => Enemies with Power less/equal than x lose HP equal to their Power (Power = Max Damage)
[*]Sacrifice:x => Lose x HP. Target suffers +2x Damage.
[*]ReactivateAlly:1 => Reactivate Target Ally
[*]Merge:1 => Discard all Actions with the same name. Gain +3 Empower for each Action discarded this way.
[*]Spellcraft[Cardname]:x => Create & Draw x [Cardname]
[*]EnemyBane[Race]:x => If Target is of [Race] deal +x Intense Damage to them.
[/list]

[h1] Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Gender Restriction Enforcer was wrongly switching the preset Race/Class combo to Human/Mercenary regardless if the preset combo was valid.
[*] Enemies in destruction queue are marked as such, so they won't get accidentally reprocessed & cause exceptions or give double xp.
[*] If for any reason the Enemy Layout is not rebuild during your turn (Enemies don't fill in the blank space between them), it will get rebuild at End of Turn.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - EA Build 0192 (Development Branch)
notes.content:
[h1] EA Build 0192 - Development Branch [/h1]

It's recommended to update in this build if you are a modder or want to play as an Ifrit, Undine or Nephilim. You'll still have to unlock any new races you want to play with tokens, or with  a mod. ;)

[h1] Misc Changes & Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 23 new Actions
[*] Added 17 New Perks
[*] Ifrit, Undine & Nephilim Races are fully playable (Have access to 12 Skills & 12 Perks and several non-Skill Actions handpicked from other Disciplines)
[*] Card Copies in the log, won't show anymore the +* postfix in their name. For simplicity they'll just display as the original Card name. i.e Angelic Shield +* => PC, will now simply display as Angelic Shield => PC.
[/list]

[h1] Modding Additions [/h1]

[h1] Synergy [/h1]

Synergy is the most awesome Keyword to date, as it can be used for all available and future effects (aside Echo). Synergy injects new effects into the next Action you'll play this turn, and this effects trigger based on your next Actions level. The applications and possibilities of what you can do with this new Keyword is (allow me to say) mind blowing! :D 
 
[list]
[*][b] Synergy[Effect]:x [/b]
[list]
[*] The next action you play this turn gains Effect:x. Effect can be any keyword except Echo, and will resolve according next action's evolution / empowerment.
[*] Value x displays with a *, because we are not in a position to know the next action & how it will evolve this value.
[*][b] Example1:[/b] SynergyDefend:3, next action gains Defend:3, but if next action is Level 2, this value will receive a +2 bonus giving you Defend +5.
[*][b] Example2:[/b] SynergyRetribution:-3, next action gains Retribution:-3, but if next action is Level 1, this value will receive a +1 bonus giving you Retribution:-2.
[*] The bonus effect is gained even if it didn't exist before in the action, if it does it modifies the existing effect by x.
[*] More than one instance of synergy can be present in an action: 
[*][b] Example3:[/b] SynergyFocus:1, SynergyMeditate:-2, next action gets both effects: draw 1* card and lose -2* AP.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1] Archetypes can now be Gender-Restricted [/h1]

Perhaps is something you want in your mods or not. And it's up to you whether you use it. But it does make a lot of sense in a supernatural world: Succubi & Nymphs according their lore are females for example while Incubi & Satyrs are male only etc. 

So if you want to gender lock certain classes and races now you can.

[list]
[*] Use "RaceGenderRestriction": "Female" or "Male" To restrict a race archetype
[*] Use "ClassGenderRestriction": "Female" or "Male" To restrict a class archetype
[*] Don't add, remove this line, or set the gender to "" to allow using this archetype regardless of gender.
[*] Ifrits & Warlocks can be picked only by Male characters (You are free to remove this restriction from their .json archetype).
[*] Nymphs & Spelldancers (of Hecate) can be picked only by Female characters  (You are free to remove this restriction from their .json archetype).
[/list]

notes.title: Announcing the Development Branch
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34785691/6d3b27f6d60457c4645384ff744ab018ef633ff6.jpg[/img]

Hi folks,

During the development of the sandbox mode all the updates will be heading directly to the Development/Beta Branch. I'll be publishing all new builds there as soon as they are stable. 

All bugfixes on reported issues and WIP implementations of 5 new races and 8 new classes inevitably will be heading there as well. If all go well I hope that both the Sandbox mode & the new Races/Classes will be mostly playable and ready for mass consumption by late June. 

Now between us: I do think that the concept of having a development branch in an EA is totally counter-intuitive. I really need your feedback and bug reports; if I didn't I would be happily developing the game in my cave, away from all the spotlights.

But I also understand that many prefer to have access to new features once they are fully implemented, therefore the beta branch. Just know, that I won't be posting any updates in the stable branch till the features I am working on are done.

So I'd like to encourage all and any brave souls, who want to truly help and actively participate in shaping the new features, races & classes to switch to the beta branch.

1) Right click on Erannorth in your Library 
2) Go to the Betas Tab
3) Choose to opt in the Development - Public Beta branch (No need for a code)

Close & Done.

I'll be posting the patch notes for the beta branch in the patch notes as usually.

[h1]Build 0191 - Development Branch[/h1]

It's not essential to update to this build, unless you need the hotfix for the uniques not showing up in trainers. Nothing will break if you do, just don't be tempted to use the new races & classes. They are still WIP.

[*] Undine

[*] Ifrit

[/list]
[*]New Classes (Not yet Playable / Placeholders)

[h1] New Actions [/h1]

Added 31 new Actions for the new Races.

[h1] Misc Changes & Additions [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added option in settings to toggle on/off a set of post-processing filters (providing additional sharpness & vibrancy) By default this setting is on, but if the game feels too vivid, you notice a drop in performance or you just prefer the older setting, you can toggle it off.
